Notes

Matrices, aligned environments, and multi-line TeX semantics are intentionally not interpreted; KaTeX on the web surface owns real typesetting.

cards.title: Streaming caret and tool timer
cards.body_html:
Problem

The activity footer had a braille spinner but no signal that text was actively streaming, and a running tool showed only the whole-turn elapsed time. Both made a slow turn look stalled.

Scope

  • Add a blinking ▍/▏ caret while assistant text is streaming.
  • Disable the caret with the existing animation-off path.
  • Show the running tool with its own elapsed seconds in the footer.
  • Clear the tool timer on result and turn end.

Acceptance

  • Responding footer alternates caret frames with animation on.
  • Animation off keeps a stable footer without a caret.
  • Running tool footer shows name · N.Ns.
  • Timer clears on tool result and turn end.
  • No transcript or event-log writes are added.

Notes

This is footer-only motion; history is not reflowed. A future slice can add a completion transition and a cancellable progress card.

cards.title: Read-only local web viewer
cards.body_html:
Problem

A terminal is the only way to inspect a session. Long Markdown, tables, and math would read better in a browser, but a web surface must not become a remote control plane or a second store.

Scope

  • niucode web --session <jsonl> [--port N], binding loopback only.
  • Embedded static client, no build step and no remote assets.
  • Endpoints: /, /api/session, /api/health, and a 501 /api/prompt.
  • Read the append-only log into a snapshot; never mutate it.
  • HTTP + loopback test and static-asset test.

Acceptance

  • Server binds 127.0.0.1 and prints the URL.
  • /api/session returns the loaded events.
  • / is an embedded HTML client with no http:///https:// assets.
  • /api/prompt is explicitly unimplemented in v0.
  • A loopback HTTP test reads the JSON body.
  • Unknown routes return 404 with no stack trace.

Notes

Chat, SSE, approvals, and KaTeX are follow-ups. This is intentionally a viewer: it proves transport, embedding, and the no-mutation boundary before adding interaction.

cards.title: Live web event tail
cards.body_html:
Problem

The web viewer loaded one snapshot. A session running in another terminal never appeared until the page was refreshed.

Scope

  • GET /api/events as a chunked text/event-stream tail of the JSONL log.
  • Send the current lines first, then append new complete lines.
  • Robust partial-line buffering; heartbeat comments while idle.
  • Client uses EventSource and shows live/reconnecting state.
  • No writes to the log; loopback only.

Acceptance

  • SSE headers are chunked and no-store.
  • The initial session_start is delivered.
  • An appended assistant_message is delivered without refresh.
  • Partial lines wait for their newline.
  • The client has no remote assets and uses EventSource.
  • A loopback test covers initial + appended events.

Notes

Still read-only: /api/prompt is 501. Browser chat and approvals need a provider/agent loop inside the server, not a file tail.

cards.title: Browser prompt, read-only
cards.body_html:
Problem

The web viewer could tail a session but the browser could not start a turn.

Scope

  • POST /api/prompt accepts {"prompt": "..."} and returns 202.
  • One turn at a time; a concurrent POST gets 409.
  • Turns are hard-coded read-only, network off, approval never.
  • The existing agent loop runs one prompt; the session log stays the truth.
  • SSE shows the user/assistant events when written.
  • Embedded composer posts the prompt.

Acceptance

  • 202 on accepted prompt; 400 on empty; 409 while busy.
  • A scripted-provider test runs a turn and writes the answer to the log.
  • The browser has a prompt form and shows errors.
  • No approval or write path is exposed.
  • Server stays loopback-only and read-only by construction.

Notes

No streaming deltas yet: the browser sees the assistant message when the turn finishes. Approvals and delta streaming need an interactive runtime bridge, not the callback engine used here.

cards.title: Stream web turns as they happen
cards.body_html:
Problem

POST /api/prompt wrote the session at turn end; the browser saw the whole answer at once. That is not comparable to a modern agent surface.

Scope

  • Bridge AgentEvent::TextDelta (and other runtime events) to SSE subscribers.
  • Keep the session log as the durable source; live events are ephemeral.
  • Client appends deltas to one assistant bubble and replaces it with the final assistant event.
  • One prompt at a time; no approvals or writes.

Acceptance

  • A broadcast channel carries runtime events to /api/events.
  • The SSE test sees text_delta before the session write completes.
  • The client renders deltas and finalizes on assistant_message.
  • Tool call events show immediately.
  • No duplicate assistant bubble after the turn.
  • The endpoint stays read-only and loopback-only.

Notes

This is a one-way stream. Browser approvals need a request/response channel and a persistent agent runtime; that is the next slice.

cards.title: Browser approvals
cards.body_html:
Problem

The web turn was hard-coded approval never and read-only. A browser client could not allow a write; the TUI and web surfaces behaved differently.

Scope

  • Web turns use workspace-write, network off, and ApprovalMode::Ask.
  • The approver sends an SSE approval event with an ID, tool, summary, and serialized preview, then blocks.
  • POST /api/approval {"id","allowed"} releases that exact turn.
  • Unknown or stale IDs return 404; the pending map is cleared after use.
  • Browser card shows the preview and Allow/Deny.
  • One prompt at a time; timeout denies after 300s.

Acceptance

  • Approval preview types serialize.
  • SSE carries the approval ID and preview.
  • POST approval releases the blocked approver (unit).
  • A scripted write turn is denied without approval and writes after Allow.
  • The browser renders Allow/Deny and reports the result.
  • Loopback-only and one-turn-at-a-time remain intact.

Notes

Approval is exposed only through the local HTTP endpoint; there is no remote auth or token. A future remote mode needs its own threat model. The 300s timeout fails closed.

cards.title: Markdown in the web transcript
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser rendered every assistant message as textContent. The TUI had rich Markdown, but the web surface did not.

Scope

  • Server-render assistant text to HTML with pulldown-cmark.
  • Enable tables and strikethrough; escape raw HTML and block javascript: links.
  • Include html in /api/session and SSE assistant events.
  • Browser replaces the streaming bubble with rendered HTML at turn end.
  • Keep plain text during deltas; no remote assets or client build.

Acceptance

  • Markdown HTML includes <strong> and <table>.
  • Raw <script> is escaped, not executed.
  • javascript: hrefs are blocked.
  • SSE/session events carry html for assistant messages.
  • Browser uses innerHTML only for server-rendered HTML.
  • CSS styles headings, lists, blockquotes, tables, and code.

Notes

Math is still the Unicode/raw text in the web client; KaTeX is the next slice. Streaming deltas stay plain text and are replaced by the final HTML.

cards.title: Math in the web transcript
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser Markdown renderer treated $...$ as text. The TUI had a Unicode fallback; the web should typeset math.

Scope

  • Extract inline and display math outside code fences.
  • Convert common TeX to native MathML with latex2mathml.
  • Preserve unmatched $ (prices) and escaped dollars.
  • Insert MathML after Markdown HTML generation so raw-HTML escaping stays on.
  • Fall back to escaped <code class="math"> when conversion fails.
  • No remote KaTeX asset or font.

Acceptance

  • Inline math becomes <math>.
  • Display $$ becomes block MathML.
  • Unmatched currency stays literal.
  • Code fences are not math-scanned.
  • A conversion failure does not inject raw HTML.
  • Browser CSS sizes MathML consistently.

Notes

Native MathML is the dependency-light v1. KaTeX can be added later as an optional local asset without changing the stored text or the API shape.

cards.title: Product system prompt for web
cards.body_html:
Problem

niucode web used the default coding-agent prompt. niuse's web entry needs its identity, user profile, memory, goals, plan, loops, and journal.

Scope

  • Make the web module public.
  • Add Options.system_prompt; the turn loop replaces the default prompt only when supplied.
  • niuse composes the prompt from its seven stores and passes it.
  • Session, transport, SSE, approval, and Markdown stay niucode-owned.

Acceptance

  • niucode::web is importable by niuse.
  • Options.system_prompt overrides the default only when set.
  • niuse composes with compose_with_plan and its thread.
  • No fork of the web server or HTML into niuse.
  • niuse builds with niucode non-optional.

Notes

The web UI still says niucode. Product branding/sidebars are the next niuse slice.

cards.title: Generic web context sidebar
cards.body_html:
Problem

The web shell was single-column and knew nothing about the embedder's product state. niuse needed identity, user, goals, plan, memory, and loops visible without forking the HTML.

Scope

  • web::Options.brand and Options.context carry product data.
  • GET /api/context returns the supplied JSON.
  • Embedded client sets the brand/title and renders generic sections.
  • Sidebar is hidden on narrow screens, fixed on wide ones.
  • No new store, no niuse-specific HTML fork.

Acceptance

  • /api/context returns the supplied JSON over loopback.
  • The client fetches it and sets brand/title.
  • Sections render as title + lines.
  • The sidebar is responsive.
  • Missing context falls back cleanly.
  • The static client has no remote assets.

Notes

niuse supplies product sections; niucode just renders them. This keeps the kernel/product boundary while allowing different embeddings.

cards.title: Web status strip
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser showed the transcript but not the model, working directory, or policy it was running under. A harness needs that at a glance.

Scope

  • GET /api/status returns brand, provider, model, cwd, sandbox, approval, network, and busy.
  • Header chips show model, cwd, and policy.
  • Refresh every 2.5s; narrow screens hide cwd/policy.
  • No new write path or remote asset.

Acceptance

  • Status endpoint is loopback-only and tested.
  • It reports workspace-write / ask / off.
  • Chips populate from the endpoint.
  • The client handles a missing endpoint.
  • Layout stays readable on narrow screens.

Notes

Busy is polled rather than pushed. A later slice can fold it into SSE phase events and show a turn timer.

cards.title: Live turn timer and collapsible context
cards.body_html:
Problem

The page showed idle from a 2.5s poll. It did not show what the agent was doing or how long the turn had been running, and the sidebar could not be hidden.

Scope

  • Fold SSE phase events into a busy chip (request, stream, tool, ...).
  • Start a 200ms timer on the first phase/text delta/approval; stop on done or turn_end.
  • Record elapsed seconds in the turn footer.
  • Add a header toggle for the context sidebar.
  • Keep the polling fallback for status but do not overwrite an active turn.

Acceptance

  • Phase events reach the client over SSE (asserted in the turn test).
  • Busy chip shows phase + elapsed.
  • turn_end clears the timer and records duration.
  • Approval switches the busy label to approval.
  • Sidebar toggle hides/shows context.
  • No new write path.

Notes

The timer is client-side; the durable usage still comes from turn_end.

cards.title: Ordered lists and horizontal rules
cards.body_html:
Problem

Bullets, tasks, and quotes were rendered, but 1. item and --- stayed raw. Markdown documents therefore looked inconsistent in the transcript.

Scope

  • Recognize N. and N) ordered markers, preserving the number.
  • Recognize ---, ***, and ___ (three or more) as a horizontal rule.
  • Render rules as a muted ─ line; leave ordered text readable.
  • Keep tables and code fences out of the rule/order path.
  • Do not treat + diff lines as lists.

Acceptance

  • 1. numbered and 2) next keep their numbers.
  • --- and *** become a rule, not raw dashes.
  • Rule text is muted in the theme.
  • PTY fixture waits for numbered lines and ────.
  • Existing bullets/tasks/quotes/table tests pass.

Notes

The rule is a fixed 40 cells, not viewport-width; terminal wrapping still keeps it safe. Table header/cell styling remains a later pass.

cards.title: Table header and border tone
cards.body_html:
Problem

Tables had the right geometry but the header and borders were visually flat. A dense table was hard to scan.

Scope

  • Return TableLine metadata (Border, Header, Row) from the table renderer.
  • Bold the header row and dim borders in the theme.
  • Preserve exact cell widths; style only attributes, never characters.
  • Apply the same tone in inline ratatui and linear ANSI modes.
  • Keep plain mode free of escape sequences.

Acceptance

  • Header spans carry BOLD; borders carry DIM.
  • Plain mode carries no modifiers.
  • Table geometry tests still pass.
  • PTY table test still passes.
  • No ANSI reaches the transcript or event log.

Notes

Inline Markdown inside cells is still stripped. Per-cell styling requires a structured cell model and remains a later pass.

cards.title: Inline styles inside table cells
cards.body_html:
Problem

Table cells were flattened to plain text: **bold** and `code` showed without their styling, unlike the same spans outside tables.

Scope

  • Parse each cell with markdown::inline, keeping text and byte ranges.
  • Carry StyledRange metadata on TableLine; width and truncation still use plain text.
  • Render bold/italic/code/link/strike/math in both inline ratatui and linear ANSI modes.
  • Truncated cells intentionally drop style ranges rather than misalign them.
  • Header bold and border dim continue to apply on top.

Acceptance

  • Cell markers are stripped and style ranges survive alignment.
  • Ratatui spans carry BOLD/CODE as appropriate.
  • Linear ANSI emits the same attributes.
  • Plain mode emits no escape codes.
  • Width/truncation tests still pass.
  • PTY table test still passes.

Notes

Styles are presentation-only and never written to the event log. Cells with inline styles inside a truncated column render plain for that cell.

cards.title: Code token highlighting
cards.body_html:
Problem

Fenced code was tokenized only by punctuation and a flat keyword list. Strings, comments, numbers, and function calls were not distinguished, so code blocks were hard to scan.

Scope

  • Add a dependency-free line classifier (syntax) with token classes: keyword, string, comment, number, function, plain.
  • Handle // and leading # comments, quoted strings with escapes, numeric literals, identifiers, and function calls.
  • Theme mapping: keywords magenta, strings green, comments dim, numbers yellow, functions cyan; plain stays default.
  • Preserve exact text; classification never changes width.
  • Use the same spans for inline and linear renderers.

Acceptance

  • Keyword/string/comment/number classification has unit tests.
  • Rebuilt tokens equal the input for representative lines.
  • Code rows carry the expected colors; plain mode carries none.
  • Existing code/markdown tests pass.
  • No new dependency.

Notes

The classifier is line-based and language-agnostic. Multi-line strings, nested block comments, and language-specific grammars are out of scope; this is a readability aid, not a compiler.

cards.title: Highlighted code in the web transcript
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser rendered fenced code as an unstyled <pre><code> block, even though the TUI had token highlighting.

Scope

  • Extract fenced code before Markdown parsing.
  • Render <pre class="code"><code class="language-…"> with token spans from the same line classifier.
  • Escape every token; sanitize the language class.
  • Insert generated blocks after Markdown HTML generation, keeping raw-HTML escaping on.
  • Style keywords, strings, comments, numbers, and functions in the embedded CSS.

Acceptance

  • Highlighted HTML includes token classes.
  • <script> inside a fence is escaped.
  • Fence markers do not reach the browser.
  • Language class is sanitized.
  • No remote syntax-highlighting asset.
  • Existing Markdown/MathML/approval tests pass.

Notes

The highlighter is line-based and shares niucode's token classifier. Multi-line comments/strings remain a later upgrade.

cards.title: Streaming Markdown in the web bubble
cards.body_html:
Problem

Text deltas were plain text; the browser only got formatted Markdown when the turn ended. That is a visible step down from a modern agent surface.

Scope

  • Keep accumulated turn text in the web observer.
  • On each TextDelta, broadcast the delta plus html for the accumulated text.
  • Reuse the same Markdown/MathML/code pipeline (escaped HTML).
  • Browser updates the streaming bubble's innerHTML when html is present and falls back to textContent otherwise.
  • Final assistant_message still replaces the bubble with durable HTML.

Acceptance

  • SSE text_delta carries html.
  • Browser uses html while streaming.
  • Raw HTML/code escaping still applies.
  • Finalization does not duplicate the bubble.
  • A scripted turn asserts html over SSE.
  • Existing approval/code/math tests pass.

Notes

The accumulated text is re-rendered per delta for local turn sizes. A token buffer or incremental renderer is a later optimization; no remote asset.

cards.title: Readable approval previews in the browser
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser approval card stringified preview as JSON. A user deciding on a write had to read raw objects instead of a diff.

Scope

  • Render PreviewBody::Diff as per-file headers and numbered add/remove/context lines with color.
  • Render Command as a command block and Note as text.
  • Escape every part with textContent; cap at 200 diff lines.
  • Show the warning when present.
  • Keep the approval POST semantics unchanged.
  • Serialize previews with a stable kind tag (tested).

Acceptance

  • Diff files show path, new flag, additions/removals, and line numbers.
  • Add/remove lines are visually distinct.
  • Command/note previews render without JSON noise.
  • Raw preview strings never become HTML.
  • Long diffs are truncated in the card.
  • Existing approval/allow/deny tests pass.

Notes

The server still sends the structured preview; rendering is client-side. The TUI keeps its own renderer for the same structure.

cards.title: Web tool call cards
cards.body_html:
Problem

Tool calls were one inline line with stringified arguments; results were a separate disclosure. Dense turns were hard to scan and the two were not visually associated.

Scope

  • Render a collapsible card per tool call: name + bounded input summary, full pretty input inside.
  • Render a result card with ✓/✗, tool name, summary, and output.
  • Escape every value with textContent.
  • Cap output height and scroll; do not write cards to the session.
  • Keep final assistant tool_calls metadata as a fallback.

Acceptance

  • Tool calls and results render as cards.
  • OK/error states are visually distinct.
  • Input/output are escaped, bounded, and scrollable.
  • The cards are collapsed by default.
  • Static client assertions cover the renderers.
  • No new server endpoint or write path.

Notes

Pairing is by event order/name; the runtime does not carry a stable call id to the browser yet. That is a later protocol slice.

cards.title: Multi-line code comment state
cards.body_html:
Problem

The syntax classifier reset on every line, so an opening /* did not color the following lines. TUI and web code looked wrong for block comments.

Scope

  • Add a stateful Highlighter with a block-comment flag.
  • /* … */ spans lines; closing comment characters are consumed and parsing resumes on the same line.
  • Reset state when a new code fence opens.
  • Web renders a whole block with one highlighter; TUI carries state per code block.
  • Preserve exact text and width.

Acceptance

  • Two-line block comments are classified as comments.
  • Code after */ is parsed as code again.
  • Rebuilt text equals the input.
  • TUI PTY fixture includes a multi-line comment.
  • Web test counts multiple tok-comment spans.
  • Existing single-line code tests pass.

Notes

Strings and triple-quoted comments are still line-based; this slice only adds Rust/C-style block comments.

cards.title: TUI tool markers
cards.body_html:
Problem

In the TUI a tool call only changed the footer, and only failures reached the transcript. A finished turn had no compact record of which tool types ran.

Scope

  • Print one → name marker per tool type per turn.
  • Do not print paths, commands, inputs, or successful outputs; those stay in details and the completion summary.
  • Keep failures explicit as ✗ name · summary.
  • Reset the marker set on TurnEnd.
  • Clip to viewport width; color arrows accent and failures danger.

Acceptance

  • Each tool type appears at most once per turn.
  • No file paths from a 100-write bulk turn reach the transcript.
  • Failures remain visible.
  • Width is clipped.
  • Volume/PTY terminal tests pass.
  • Unit tests cover call/result formatting.

Notes

This preserves the bounded transcript design: success evidence stays merged in the completion line. The web surface owns full tool cards (M9-025).

cards.title: Triple-quoted multi-line strings
cards.body_html:
Problem

Block comments spanned lines, but Python-style """…""" / '''…''' docstrings reset on every line and were highlighted as code.

Scope

  • Track an optional triple-quote in the stateful highlighter.
  • Opening and closing triples stay one String token across lines.
  • Code after the closing triple on the same line resumes normal parsing.
  • TUI and web share the state; exact text and width are preserved.
  • Single-quoted strings and backticks keep the existing line behavior.

Acceptance

  • Triple-quoted bodies are String tokens across lines.
  • Closing triple resumes parsing; following numbers classify.
  • Rebuilt text equals the input.
  • Web test finds multiple tok-string spans.
  • Existing block-comment/code tests pass.

Notes

Raw strings (r#"…"#), nested triples, and multi-line backticks are still out of scope.

cards.title: Collapsible and filterable context sidebar
cards.body_html:
Problem

The product sidebar grew to seven sections plus a report. It was a long scroll with no way to focus on one part.

Scope

  • Render each context section as a native <details> with a line count.
  • Add a local filter input; hide sections that do not match.
  • Keep section content escaped with textContent.
  • No new API, store, or write path; context is still a page-load snapshot.
  • Collapse state is per-render, not persisted.

Acceptance

  • Sections are collapsible and open by default.
  • Counts reflect the rendered lines.
  • Filter hides non-matching sections.
  • Clearing the filter restores all sections.
  • Static client assertions cover ctx-section and ctx-filter.
  • Existing sidebar/status/timer tests pass.

Notes

Persisting collapsed groups or pushing context over SSE is a later slice.

cards.title: Live product context and remembered sections
cards.body_html:
Problem

/api/context was a one-shot snapshot. After a turn changed memory, goals, or metrics, the sidebar stayed stale. Collapsing a section was forgotten on reload.

Scope

  • Add optional Options.context_provider, called per /api/context request.
  • Static context remains the fallback.
  • Client refreshes context after turn_end and every 15s.
  • Collapsed sections persist in localStorage, keyed by title.
  • Filter state and escaping remain unchanged.
  • No new write path or remote asset.

Acceptance

  • A provider is called on each context request (loopback test).
  • Static context still works without a provider.
  • Browser refreshes after a turn and on interval.
  • Collapse state persists across reloads.
  • Section content stays escaped.
  • Existing sidebar/filter tests pass.

Notes

Refresh is polling, not SSE; the context payload is small enough for now. A future context_changed event could replace the timer.

cards.title: Multi-line web composer
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser composer was one <input> line. Long prompts were hard to write and there was no newline.

Scope

  • Replace the input with a one-row <textarea>.
  • Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
  • Auto-grow up to 160px; reset after submit.
  • Keep the form POST/approval path unchanged.
  • Add a visible keyboard hint.

Acceptance

  • Textarea is present and styled like the old input.
  • Enter submits; Shift+Enter does not.
  • Height grows with content and caps at 160px.
  • Submit clears and resets height.
  • Static client assertions cover textarea and hint.
  • No server/API changes.

Notes

IME composition is handled by the browser; a future slice can add paste/file attachments and a submit shortcut hint per platform.

cards.title: Web prompt history
cards.body_html:
Problem

The web composer discarded every prompt. Repeating a long request meant retyping it, unlike the TUI's history.

Scope

  • Persist the last 50 submitted prompts in localStorage, newest first.
  • Deduplicate; submitting an existing prompt moves it to the front.
  • ↑ at the start of a single-line draft recalls older prompts; ↓ moves forward and clears at the newest.
  • Do not hijack arrows in multi-line drafts.
  • Keep history local; no server route or store.

Acceptance

  • History is stored under niucode.prompt.history.
  • Newest-first, deduplicated, capped at 50.
  • Arrow-up/down recall works and ↓ clears at the newest.
  • Multi-line drafts keep normal cursor behavior.
  • Static client assertions cover history.
  • No API or write-path change.

Notes

Per-workspace histories and a visible history menu are later options.

cards.title: Copy button for web code blocks
cards.body_html:
Problem

Code blocks were highlighted but not copyable without selecting text, which is awkward for long commands and diffs.

Scope

  • After a final assistant HTML render, add a Copy button to each pre.code.
  • Copy the <code> text via navigator.clipboard.
  • Show Copied for 1.2s; show Copy failed if the API rejects.
  • Do not add buttons during every streamed delta.
  • No server route, dependency, or remote asset.

Acceptance

  • Every highlighted code block gets a button.
  • The button is idempotent when rendering again.
  • Clipboard success/failure is visible.
  • Static client assertions cover copy-code.
  • Existing code/Markdown tests pass.

Notes

Some browsers require a secure context for Clipboard; localhost qualifies. A future slice can copy whole messages or tool output.

cards.title: Context changed event over SSE
cards.body_html:
Problem

The sidebar refreshed on a 600ms timeout after turn_end plus a 15s poll. The server knew exactly when a turn finished and the product context might have changed, but never said so.

Scope

  • After a web turn finishes (success or error), broadcast {"type":"context_changed"} on the existing SSE channel.
  • The client calls loadContext() immediately.
  • Keep the interval and turn-end timeout as fallbacks.
  • No new endpoint, store, or write path.

Acceptance

  • The event is emitted after a scripted turn.
  • The SSE turn test waits for context_changed.
  • The browser reloads context on the event.
  • Existing context/timer/approval tests pass.
  • Static client assertions cover the event.

Notes

This is a hint, not a snapshot; the client still fetches /api/context. External edits to Markdown stores are covered by the periodic refresh.

cards.title: Local slash commands in the web composer
cards.body_html:
Problem

Every entered line was sent to the model. The TUI has local slash commands, but the browser had no way to inspect status or jump to the report without spending a turn.

Scope

  • /help lists the local commands.
  • /status prints model, cwd, sandbox/approval, and network from /api/status.
  • /report clears the context filter, reloads context, and filters to the report section.
  • Commands are handled in the client and never POSTed.
  • Commands remain in local prompt history; nothing is written to the session.
  • Unknown /… still goes to the agent (for now).

Acceptance

  • /help, /status, and /report do not call /api/prompt.
  • Status comes from the existing endpoint.
  • Report uses the existing context/sidebar path.
  • Input and height reset after local commands.
  • Static client assertions cover /help.
  • Existing prompt/approval tests pass.

Notes

Unknown slash commands are intentionally not intercepted; a later slice can add strict command routing and /clear semantics tied to a new session.

cards.title: Reject unknown web slash commands locally
cards.body_html:
Problem

/foo was sent to the model, unlike the TUI, which treats unknown slash commands as local input errors. That spent a turn and could confuse the agent.

Scope

  • Recognize known local commands first.
  • Any other /… prints unknown command · /help locally.
  • Do not POST, do not start a turn, do not write the session.
  • Keep the input cleared and height reset.
  • Keep known command behavior unchanged.

Acceptance

  • Unknown slash commands never call /api/prompt.
  • The message points at /help.
  • Known commands still work.
  • Static client assertions cover the path.
  • Existing prompt/approval tests pass.

Notes

This matches the TUI's "unknown /foo is not model input" rule. /clear is still intentionally unavailable until real session semantics exist.

cards.title: Slash-command menu in the web composer
cards.body_html:
Problem

The local commands were only discoverable through /help; typing a slash gave no feedback.

Scope

  • Show a menu above the composer while the input starts with /.
  • Filter by prefix; show name and description.
  • Tab or click fills the command; ↑/↓ move the active item.
  • Hide the menu for spaces, empty prefixes, or no matches.
  • No server route; commands still execute through the local handler.

Acceptance

  • / opens a menu of known commands.
  • Prefix filtering works.
  • Tab/click fills the command without sending it.
  • Arrow keys cycle items.
  • Menu is hidden for non-command input.
  • Static client assertions cover cmd-menu.

Notes

Full keyboard handling of history vs menu when both are active is intentionally simple; the menu wins only for Tab/arrows when visible.

cards.title: View-only /clear in the web transcript
cards.body_html:
Problem

Long browser transcripts had no way to clear the view without reloading, which would also refetch and re-render the whole session.

Scope

  • /clear clears the DOM transcript and streaming state only.
  • Print view cleared · session log unchanged so the semantics are explicit.
  • Do not POST, write the session, create a new session, or reset the sidebar.
  • Add /clear to the command menu and /help.
  • Keep unknown-slash rejection.

Acceptance

  • /clear empties the transcript view.
  • It explicitly says the session log is unchanged.
  • No API call or session write occurs.
  • Streaming state is reset.
  • Command menu/help include it.
  • Static client assertions cover the note.

Notes

A true new-session command needs server-side session switching and SSE reconnect semantics; this slice deliberately avoids implying that.

cards.title: Token usage chip in the web header
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser showed elapsed time but not how many tokens a turn used or how much the page had consumed. A harness should make cost visible.

Scope

  • Accumulate input_tokens, output_tokens, and cached_tokens from turn_end events.
  • Show a compact N in / N out chip; tooltip shows cached input.
  • Load initial session usage as its events stream in.
  • Keep totals page-local; no server state or pricing claims.
  • Reset on a page reload.

Acceptance

  • The header has a usage chip.
  • Amounts compact to k/m.
  • Cached tokens are available in the tooltip.
  • Initial session events contribute.
  • Static client assertions cover usage.
  • No API or store changes.

Notes

Page-local totals are not the same as a session-wide billing ledger. A future slice can ask /api/status for durable usage.

cards.title: Download the web session as Markdown
cards.body_html:
Problem

The browser could read a session but not take it anywhere. Users had to find the JSONL on disk and convert it themselves.

Scope

  • GET /api/export derives Markdown from the append-only log.
  • Include cwd/model/provider, user/assistant text, tool outputs in four-backtick fences, token usage, and compaction summaries.
  • Serve text/markdown with an attachment filename.
  • Add a header Download button that fetches and saves it locally.
  • Return a JSON 500 if the session cannot be loaded.
  • No new file, store, or mutation.

Acceptance

  • Export has a title and session metadata.
  • User/assistant/tool output are preserved.
  • Tool output fences tolerate embedded triple backticks.
  • The response has an attachment filename.
  • Browser button downloads the blob.
  • Unit tests cover the Markdown shape.

Notes

The export is a projection, never a second source of truth. Durable session formats and replay semantics are unchanged.

cards.title: Search the web transcript
cards.body_html:
Problem

Long browser sessions had no search. Finding an earlier command or answer meant scrolling and manual reading.

Scope

  • Add a transcript search input above the log.
  • Filter direct log children (messages, cards, approvals) by visible text.
  • Show visible / total while filtering; clear the count otherwise.
  • Esc clears the search.
  • No backend, index, or session write.

Acceptance

  • Search filters visible messages.
  • Count reflects visible/total.
  • Escape clears.
  • Clearing restores everything.
  • Static client assertions cover filterTranscript.
  • Existing chat/render tests pass.

Notes

Filtering hides DOM nodes with hidden; it never removes evidence or changes the session. A later slice can mark matches, add next/previous, or search tool output only.

cards.title: MSRV-clean and package-verifiable web stack
cards.body_html:
Problem

cargo +1.88.0 check --workspace --all-targets emitted five unused-assignment warnings in the TUI. More seriously, cargo package -p niucode failed because the web approval path serialized ChangePreview, a derive added in the local niucode-tools but absent in the registry version used by the package.

Scope

  • Remove the redundant line_open/thinking assignments in tui.rs.
  • Replace direct preview serialization with a local preview_json projection over the public preview types.
  • Verify the package tarball includes assets/web.html and src/web.rs.
  • Re-run MSRV and package checks.

Acceptance

  • cargo +1.88.0 check --workspace --all-targets has no warnings.
  • cargo package -p niucode --allow-dirty verifies.
  • Web approval JSON keeps the same diff/command/note shape.
  • Web tests still pass.
  • No behavior change to terminal output.

Notes

The package verifies at the current unreleased version. A real release still needs coordinated crate version bumps and publication order (tools/core before the CLI).

cards.title: Start a new web session
cards.body_html:
Problem

The web viewer was pinned to the session passed on the command line. /clear only cleared the DOM; there was no honest way to start fresh.

Scope

  • Make the server's session path mutable under a mutex.
  • POST /api/new creates a new JSONL in the current session's directory, appends SessionStart + Policy, and switches the server to it.
  • Return 403 when allow_new is false, 409 while a turn runs.
  • Update /api/session's snapshot for the new file.
  • /new in the browser posts, shows the id, and reloads; SSE reconnects to the new path.
  • Embedders can supply new_session_provider; niuse uses it to archive the current thread and recreate thread.jsonl.

Acceptance

  • /api/new creates another log and changes the active path.
  • The new file exists and has a session header.
  • Busy/disabled paths fail closed; an embedder provider is used when set.
  • /new is in help and the command menu.
  • Existing path uses read a consistent locked clone.
  • Tests cover creation over loopback.

Notes

Old SSE connections keep tailing the old file until the page reloads. niuse archives the active thread and creates a fresh one through the provider hook.

cards.title: Follow the latest web message without stealing scroll
cards.body_html:
Problem

Streamed output could land below the fold, and a naive always-scroll would yank the page while the user was reading earlier evidence.

Scope

  • Before rendering an event, check whether the viewport is near the bottom.
  • If it is, scroll to the latest after the DOM updates; otherwise leave scroll alone.
  • Show a floating ↓ Latest button when not at the bottom.
  • Re-evaluate on scroll (passive listener).
  • No server, store, or event change.

Acceptance

  • Near-bottom readers follow new output.
  • Scrolled-up readers are not moved.
  • Latest button appears away from bottom and works.
  • Static client assertions cover the helper.
  • Existing chat/stream tests pass.

Notes

The threshold is 160px. Smooth scrolling is used; reduced-motion handling can be added with prefers-reduced-motion later.

cards.title: Light theme and reduced motion in web
cards.body_html:
Problem

The web shell was dark-only. A user who needs a light surface or reduced motion had no control, and smooth scroll ignored the OS preference.

Scope

  • Promote core colors to CSS variables with a body.light override.
  • Add a ☾/☀ header toggle persisted in localStorage.
  • Override diff/token/approval colors for light mode.
  • Add prefers-reduced-motion CSS and make jump-to-latest use auto when reduced motion is requested.
  • No server, store, or event changes.

Acceptance

  • Light variables cover background, panel, text, border, code.
  • Toggle persists across reloads.
  • Light-mode diff/token overrides remain readable.
  • Reduced-motion media query exists.
  • Latest scroll honors reduced motion.
  • Static client assertions cover theme and motion.

Notes

The theme is a presentation preference only; it never touches the transcript or session. A future slice can add a high-contrast variant.

cards.title: HTTP contract coverage for export and new session
cards.body_html:
Problem

Export and new-session behavior had unit coverage but their HTTP contracts (status, content type, disposition, disabled handling) were untested.

Scope

  • Add loopback tests for:
    • GET /api/export → 200, text/markdown, attachment filename, body.
    • POST /api/new with allow_new: false → 403.
  • Keep existing create/allow tests.
  • No production behavior change unless a test exposes a defect.

Acceptance

  • Export response carries the Markdown content type and disposition.
  • Exported body includes the session title and user text.
  • Disabled new-session returns 403.
  • Tests use the same state helper and loopback server.
  • Full web test suite passes.

Notes

These are protocol-level tests; browser behavior remains covered by static client assertions.

cards.title: Distinct TUI heading levels
cards.body_html:
Problem

Every ATX heading rendered identically: accent, bold. A long Markdown document had no visible hierarchy.

Scope

  • Preserve the heading level in the parser (heading_with_level).
  • Keep heading() as the text-only wrapper for existing callers.
  • Theme:
    • # → accent bold + underline
    • ## → accent bold
    • ###+ → cyan, not bold
  • Text and marker stripping are unchanged.
  • Plain mode emits no attributes.

Acceptance

  • Levels 1/3 parse correctly; level 7 and #hashtag do not.
  • H1 carries underline; H3 loses bold.
  • Content stays exactly the heading text.
  • Existing heading/table/PTY tests pass.
  • No event-log change.

Notes

Underline is ANSI/ratatui presentation only. Terminal themes may render it differently, but text and width are stable.

cards.title: /threads context command
cards.body_html:
Problem

The generic context sidebar can contain an archived-thread section, but there was no quick way to focus it from the composer.

Scope

  • Add local /threads command.
  • Clear/set the context filter to threads, reload context, report in status.
  • Add it to /help and the completion menu.
  • Keep unknown-slash rejection and no model turn.
  • No server route or session switching.

Acceptance

  • /threads is local and never calls /api/prompt.
  • It filters the context sidebar through the existing path.
  • Help/menu include it.
  • Static client assertion covers it.
  • Existing commands tests pass.

Notes

This only focuses an embedder-provided section. Real switching between archived sessions needs a separate path/session protocol.

cards.title: Switch archived sessions from web
cards.body_html:
Problem

Archived threads were visible but inert. Selecting a chapter required leaving the browser and manipulating files.

Scope

  • Add Options.switch_session_provider (id → allowlisted path).
  • POST /api/switch {"id"} updates the active path and snapshot; 400 on bad id, 403 when disabled, 409 while a turn runs.
  • Context sections with kind: "threads" render as buttons.
  • Clicking asks for confirmation, posts, and reloads onto the new SSE path.
  • Embedder owns validation and archive/move semantics.

Acceptance

  • Provider-backed switch returns 200 and changes the active path.
  • Switch snapshot covers the target events.
  • Disabled switch fails closed.
  • Bad ids are rejected by the provider.
  • Thread section renders buttons and confirmation.
  • Existing new/clear/context tests pass.

Notes

The server does not infer thread ids or touch the filesystem; it only invokes the embedder provider. niuse archives the active thread and moves the selected chapter back to thread.jsonl.

cards.title: Broadcast session switches over SSE
cards.body_html:
Problem

Only the tab that posted /api/switch or /api/new reloaded. Other open tabs kept tailing the old session and showed stale state.

Scope

  • After a successful switch/new, broadcast {"type":"session_switched"} on the existing live channel.
  • Client reloads on the event; the requester's timed reload remains harmless.
  • No new endpoint or storage.
  • Add an SSE assertion to the switch test.

Acceptance

  • Switch broadcasts session_switched.
  • New session broadcasts it too.
  • The switch HTTP test reads the event over SSE.
  • Client reloads on the event.
  • Existing prompt/approval/context tests pass.

Notes

This closes the cross-tab window; connections still finish against the old file until the reload is processed.

cards.title: Per-tool timing history
cards.body_html:
Problem

The footer showed only the currently running tool and the whole-turn elapsed time. After completion there was no record of which tool consumed the time.

Scope

  • Track elapsed time per tool name while a tool runs.
  • Aggregate per name (not per call), so a 100-write turn stays one line.
  • At task completion, print tools · name 1.2s · ..., sorted by duration, bounded to six names and clipped to width.
  • Clear after the task summary.
  • No transcript writes per call and no event-log change.

Acceptance

  • Durations aggregate by tool name.
  • Output is deterministic, sorted, and width-clipped.
  • Empty map produces no line.
  • Volume/PTY terminal tests still pass.
  • No file paths or outputs enter the timing line.

Notes

Timing is presentation-only and lives in memory. Durable per-call timing would need a new event field and is out of scope.

cards.title: High-contrast web theme
cards.body_html:
Problem

Dark and light modes were both low-contrast surfaces. Users who need stronger separation had no option.

Scope

  • Add a body.contrast variable set: black surfaces, white text/borders, yellow accent, strong success/error.
  • Override diff and code-token colors for contrast.
  • Cycle the theme button dark → light → high contrast → dark; persist the mode.
  • Keep reduced-motion behavior unchanged.
  • No server or session change.

Acceptance

  • Contrast variables override core colors.
  • Theme cycles through three modes and persists.
  • Diff/token colors have contrast overrides.
  • Button label reflects the mode.
  • Static client assertion covers body.contrast.
  • Existing theme/reduced-motion tests pass.

Notes

Contrast is a presentation preference. A future slice can honor prefers-contrast: more automatically.

cards.title: Web accessibility and OS preference pass
cards.body_html:
Problem

Icon-only controls had no accessible names, the transcript had no log role, and the theme default ignored the OS color-scheme/contrast preference.

Scope

  • Add a skip-to-transcript link.
  • Label context/sidebar/theme/download/search/filter/prompt controls.
  • Mark the transcript role="log" with polite live updates; live/busy chips are polite live regions.
  • First-run theme: saved value wins; else prefers-contrast: more → high contrast, else prefers-color-scheme: light → light, else dark.
  • Auto selection is not persisted until the user toggles.
  • No server/session changes.

Acceptance

  • Icon buttons have aria-label.
  • Transcript has role="log" and an accessible name.
  • Search/filter/prompt inputs are labeled.
  • OS contrast/light preference influences the first theme.
  • Explicit toggles persist; auto selection does not.
  • Static assertions cover log role and contrast preference.

Notes

Streaming updates on a polite live region can still be chatty; a "announce final only" mode is a possible follow-up.

cards.title: DOM id consistency test for the web client
cards.body_html:
Problem

The embedded client is a single HTML file. A typo in an id or a getElementById call would silently break a control, and no test noticed.

Scope

  • Parse id="…" values and getElementById('…') references from the embedded client.
  • Assert IDs are unique and every referenced ID exists.
  • Keep the existing no-remote-assets assertion.
  • No runtime change.

Acceptance

  • All current IDs are unique.
  • Every getElementById reference resolves.
  • Test runs offline in the Rust suite.
  • Embedded script parses with node --check in the audit.
  • Existing static/JS tests pass.

Notes

This is a structural canary, not a DOM runtime test. A headless-browser smoke test remains a future CI upgrade.

cards.title: Headless browser smoke test
cards.body_html:
Problem

DOM id checks and node --check prove structure and syntax, not that the single file actually loads in a browser.

Scope

  • Optional integration test using CHROME or google-chrome.
  • Stub EventSource so no server is needed; fetch failures are already caught.
  • Load the file over file://, dump the DOM with a virtual time budget, and assert the log role, brand, and composer are present.
  • Skip when Chrome is unavailable; kill after 20s.
  • No new dependency or required CI browser.

Acceptance

  • Test passes locally with Chrome.
  • Test skips cleanly without Chrome.
  • No server or network asset is required.
  • Assertions cover transcript role, brand, and prompt.
  • Existing Rust/static tests pass.

Notes

A future CI image can add Chrome and make this non-optional. Screenshot regression is still out of scope.

cards.title: Visual audit fixes blank header chip buttons
cards.body_html:
Problem

A real headless-Chrome render showed the theme, download, and context-toggle buttons as blank blue pills. The global button rule set a blue background and small dark text; .chip only changed the border, so the labels were effectively invisible.

Scope

  • Add button.chip overrides: panel background, dim text, hover accent border.
  • Keep the global primary button style for Send/Allow.
  • Add a static client assertion for button.chip.
  • Capture dark and light screenshots through headless Chrome as audit evidence.

Acceptance

  • Header chip buttons are readable in light and dark themes.
  • Send remains the primary button.
  • Static assertion covers the override.
  • Headless smoke test and existing web tests pass.
  • No layout or session change.

Notes

This is the first visual regression caught by the headless path. Screenshot diffing in CI remains future work.

docs.title: 架构
docs.summary: niucode 的边界、数据流、事件生命周期与明确不做的事。
docs.body_html:
一句话

niucode 是一个围绕 append-only 事件日志 构建的最小 coding agent harness：一个 turn 引擎、一层薄 provider 适配、工具面、三条安全轴。当前最小闭环已有六个基础工具和一个只读 subagent 编排工具，Linux bash 默认走 bwrap 沙箱。

设计约束

  1. 日志是唯一真相。 内存里的对话是日志的投影。任何不落盘的状态，进程退出即不存在。
  2. 上下文是产品。 模型看到什么、按什么顺序看到、何时压缩，决定了 agent 的上限。
  3. 工具少而锋利。 每多一个工具，就多一份 schema、一类失败模式和一段 prompt。
  4. provider 层要薄。 只归一化够用的部分，不试图抹平所有 wire format 怪癖。
  5. 安全边界要诚实。 进程内路径校验不是沙箱；bash 能绕过的东西，不能假装它不能。

数据流

user input
   │
   ▼
 CLI ──► runtime ──► loop ──► context.project(log, budget) ──► provider.stream
            │                                          │
            │                                     StreamEvent
            │                                          ▼
            │                                   assistant message
            │                                          │
            ├────────────── tool calls ◄───────────────┘
            │                   │
            │                   ├──► sandbox.guard
            │                   └──► tools.dispatch (read-only 并发，写串行)
            │
            └──► session.append(every event, flush)

一个 turn 的边界是 user_message 到 turn_end。loop 只做四件事：投影、请求、派发、追加。它不解析 SSE，不实现工具，不渲染 UI。

事件生命周期

事件何时写入关键字段
session_start创建会话id、cwd、model
user_message用户输入text
assistant_message一次模型响应结束text、reasoning、tool_calls
tool_result每个工具执行完call_id、ok、output
turn_end一次模型响应结束，不代表任务成功usage（含 cached / reasoning）、可选 finish_reason
init_proposal/init 生成完整提案content、path
instructions每次 run 发现 AGENTS.mdsources、digest
forkfork 出新 sessionparent、parent_event
subagent_spawn父 session 启动只读子任务id、call_id、task、session、预算
subagent_result子任务结束id、ok、summary、session、turns、usage
plan_modeplan mode 开关active
verification人显式运行一次检查后command、ok、output（有界尾部）、可选 step
goal_set / goal_cleared会话目标text / 清除
goal_verdict/goal run evaluator 结论status、reason
model_change运行时模型选择provider、model
permission_change运行时权限 profileprofile、sandbox、approval、network
extension_mount / extension_unmountsidecar 挂载/卸载name、version、tools、capabilities、digest、workers
extension_errorsidecar 挂载/调用失败name、message
compaction上下文压缩summary、upto、before/after tokens
session_end正常退出ts
input_submitted / input_applied运行中接收 / 注入下一请求id、text、queued
task_started / task_finished一次独立任务边界id、cwd / status
tool_evidence已完成工具的结构化证据call_id、process / change / conflict
task_snapshot任务前后受预算限制的磁盘快照task_id、phase、files、coverage
check_snapshot命令退出后、释放 W1 前call_id、workspace digest

compaction.upto 是事件日志的绝对下标：摘要替换 events[..upto]。compaction 事件本身追加在日志末尾，但投影时在 upto 处插入摘要。resume 只使用最后一个 compaction；原始事件永远保留。

事件 ID 是解码事件的 1-based 序号（e000012），不写进事件内容；append-only 保证稳定，坏行不制造 ID。replay 按 user turn 重建投影，不调用模型；fork 复制前缀并在末尾追加 fork 事件，前缀下标和 compaction.upto 不变。见 ADR-0010。

模块边界

层模块职责
InterfaceCLI / TUI参数、生命周期、渲染；不持有对话状态
EngineLoop / Context编排、投影、压缩；不碰 wire format
AdaptersProviders / Tools / Sandbox / Auth外部世界与凭证的适配；不依赖 UI
StateSession追加、加载、容错；不解释业务
EngineeringDashboard架构阅读面（默认 Architecture）；不参与运行时

依赖方向只能向下：Interface → Engine → Adapters / State。niucode-core 不依赖 niucode-cli，TUI 不 import loop 内部。

CLI 的 text_layout 集中处理输入/输出的字素布局与控制字符可视化；静态输出不创建 Composer，不生成编辑历史或光标映射。Composer 持有输入状态，TerminalSession 持有 终端模式；布局模块不读写会话，见 ADR-0028 的文本布局补充。

工具面

六个基础工具：read、write、edit、grep、glob、bash；M3 增加一个只读 subagent 编排工具。

  • read 带行号，单次上限约 2000 行 / 50KB，截断时给出续读方式。
  • edit 用精确字符串替换，要求唯一匹配，返回小 diff；行号会漂移，不用行号。
  • bash 只回尾部约 20KB，完整输出落临时文件；超时杀进程组，不留孤儿。
  • 工具错误是 prompt 的一部分：写清楚"为什么失败、下一步怎么做"。

write / edit 前必须读过目标文件。这是策略层强制，不是提示词建议。

审批前由 Toolbox::preview 读取真实文件，生成结构化 unified diff（文件、hunk、行号、增删行）。loop 只转发 ChangePreview，TUI 与 headless 各自渲染；UI 不复制路径策略，预览也不修改工作区。决策见 ADR-0007。

Subagent

subagent 是第七个工具，也是唯一的编排工具：接收 1–4 个任务，并行运行，每个任务一个独立 session 日志。

  • profile: explore（默认）：read / grep / glob + 只读 external tools；sandbox read-only + network off；没有 write/edit/bash，也没有 subagent，不能递归。
  • profile: worker：read / write / edit / grep / glob / bash + 只读 external tools；继承父 sandbox；write_scope 约束 write/edit 路径。
  • W1：父和所有 Worker 共享一个全局 write lock；write/edit/bash 串行。bash 不受 path scope 约束。
  • profile: inherit 需要显式 --allow-subagent-inheritance；复制父工具面，但剥离 subagent，不能递归。
  • mutating external tools 和 full-access 不默认下放给子 agent。
  • 父 session 记录 subagent_spawn（含 profile）/ subagent_result，包含子 session 路径；子 session_start.id 等于 spawn id。
  • 父模型只收到一条 tool_result：每个任务的摘要 + 日志路径；完整 transcript 留在子日志里。
  • 每个任务有独立 max_steps、timeout_secs 和 context budget；超时/失败返回 ok=false，父 agent 继续。决策见 ADR-0011/0014。

Plan mode 与 Goal

/plan 是运行时 mode，不是 profile：进入后 tool allowlist 收窄到 read/grep/glob，system prompt 注入只读计划指令；退出恢复原 profile。/goal <condition> 在 TUI 中设置目标并立即启动 goal run（最多 6 轮）；/goal run 重新启动已有目标，/goal stop / /goal clear 停止。每轮结束用独立无工具 evaluator 写 goal_verdict；goal 不改变权限。headless exec --goal 是 M4-008。决策见 ADR-0014。

External tools

niucode-extension 是一个 session 级 sidecar host。它在 <workspace>/.niucode/extensions/*.toml 发现 manifest，spawn 本地进程，通过 line-delimited JSON-RPC 完成 initialize / tools/call / shutdown。工具在 initialize 时注册，合并进 agent 的 tool specs；调用按插件串行（M4-002 的并发模型是保守的）。sidecar 启动时 env_clear，不继承 API key；超时/崩溃返回 tool error。父 session 追加 extension_mount / extension_unmount / extension_error。没有 manifest 时不产生任何进程。capability sandbox、worker pool、subagent 共享 host 是 M4-007。决策见 ADR-0013。

JSONL 协议

niucode exec --json 在 stdout 输出一行一个 JSON 事件，第一行 start 带 protocol: 1。事件类型与 AgentEvent 同构，另有 start / done / cancelled / error。tool_result 只含 summary，完整 output 在 session 日志。stderr 保留人类诊断；--approval ask 在 JSON 模式下被拒绝。决策见 ADR-0012。

生成 finish_reason=length 记录 usage 和响应后返回错误，不派发该响应的工具， 不发任务完成；CLI/TUI 复用 runtime 错误路径，见 ADR-0030。

上下文与压缩

  • project_history(events) 是全量日志到模型上下文的有损投影；compaction 在 cutoff 处插入一条 system handoff。
  • system + tools + 历史前缀保持稳定，易变内容放末尾，以命中 provider 的 prompt cache。
  • 每次 run 从 cwd 向上发现 AGENTS.md，近者优先，追加在稳定 base system prompt 之后；修改后下一次用户 turn 生效。加载结果记录为 instructions 事件（sources + digest），用于定位 prompt cache 前缀变化。
  • 到估算预算 75% 触发 compaction：默认保留最近 3 个 user turn 原文，其余生成确定性 handoff：目标、上一次请求、已完成、改动文件、最近助手状态、近期失败、约束、下一步。
  • 单个 turn 很长时，回退到该 turn 内安全的 assistant 边界，保留尾部；tool call 和 tool result 不会被切开。
  • 先构造候选投影并确认 token 估算下降，才把 compaction 事件落盘；失败保留原上下文并提示。
  • 压缩结果落成事件，不修改历史。token 估算见 ADR-0008。
  • 缓存命中率由 turn_end.usage 的 cached / input 派生，TUI、exec 与 session show 直接显示；不写第二份 metrics 文件。见 ADR-0009。

安全

三条正交的轴，不要揉成一个开关：

  • sandbox：read-only / workspace-write / full-access。
  • approval：ask / on-failure / never。
  • network：on / off。

Linux 第一后端用 bwrap namespace：只读根 + workspace bind，network off 用独立 net namespace。没有 bwrap 时，never 启动失败，on-failure / ask 降级为逐工具审批并提示网络策略未执行。landlock/seccomp 与 macOS seatbelt 是后续后端，见 ADR-0006。

路径策略与 shell 隔离分开：文件工具在进程内 canonicalize；bash 的外部隔离由 bwrap 提供。两者都不是 VM，工作区外文件默认可读。

明确不做

  • 不做通用 agent framework，不为未知用例抽象。
  • 不做通用 everything-is-plugin、MCP 全家桶、多 provider 全家桶、通用多 agent 框架；M4 只做 capability 级 external tools/commands（ADR-0013），loop/context/policy/auth 仍在 kernel。
  • 不在离线项目看板里加运行时 Runs / metrics 视图；那属于未来的 runtime viewer（ADR-0009）。
  • 不做浏览器里可编辑的看板；状态变更走仓库。
  • 不在 loop 里做 prompt 字符串拼接；prompt 是独立、可版本化的输入。

开放问题

公开 harness 评测设施位于 benchmarks/，属于 engineering，见 评测计划 和 ADR-0029。 容器 runner、独立 grader、费用网关不进入 agent/core；网关凭证经 niucode-auth。 评测结果不充当会话状态，也不替代终端验收。

M6 的目标契约和具体迁移计划见 可靠的终端结对编码实施计划 及 ADR-0028。共享编辑器、终端 owner、运行时命令/事件、prepared mutation 和证据审阅已落地。 新增事件只记录持久事实；排队、上下文和审阅仍从日志投影。SessionLog 内部串行化追加，写失败后停止。 实机与压力验收见 终端验收记录；M5 的真实 Ghostty gate 保持有效。

  1. assistant_message 是否要保留 reasoning 原文，还是只保留摘要？不同 provider 的回传要求不同。
  2. 确定性 handoff 在什么任务上开始丢意图？需要模型生成 handoff 时，如何限制额外调用成本？
  3. 工具并行度：只读并发之外，是否允许不同文件的写并发？
  4. 事件 schema 的演进策略：加字段兼容，还是显式版本迁移？

docs.title: Roadmap 与学习路径
docs.summary: 从 M0 到可用 coding harness：组件地图、自研/用库边界，以及每个阶段应该真正学会的东西。
docs.body_html:
目标

不是“所有 agent 功能”，而是一个可靠的单 agent coding harness：

给一个真实 repo 和一个 issue，agent 能定位、修改、跑测试、给出 diff；失败能 resume；同一 fixture 可以离线回归。

平台层（MCP、插件、subagent、多 provider、长期记忆）不是“完整”的必要条件；先证明单 agent 闭环。

组件地图

M0–M5 kernel 退出条件已满足，M6 Reliable pairing active；实现进入 review，M5-003/M5-006 的独立终端验收状态保持。 见 M6 实施计划 和 ADR-0028：统一编辑与渲染 → 运行中协作 → 冲突检测与证据审阅 → Linux/macOS 真实终端验收。 代码质量门槛包含删除重复实现、单一事件日志 writer、有界队列和完整取消路径；实现卡记录本地证据；M6-009 等待真实终端矩阵和压力验收，见 terminal-acceptance。 下方初期学习顺序保留为历史背景，当前状态以工作卡与 project.json 为准。

  • Runtime / loop（M0-008）— 自研 Command/Event 与 turn 状态机；用 tokio。学会：画出命令/事件生命周期，说明取消发生在哪。
  • Provider（M0-005）— 自研流式归一化、SSE 映射、错误分类；用 reqwest。学会：解释重试边界和 token 账本。
  • Tools（M0-006/007）— 自研注册表与六个工具；用 serde_json / ignore / globset。学会：证明工具输出不会撑爆上下文。
  • Context（M2-001/002）— 自研 projection、compaction、AGENTS.md 合并。学会：解释“日志全量、上下文有损”。
  • State（M0-002/009）— 自研 Event、JSONL、resume、fork；用 serde_json。学会：离线回放一次真实 turn。
  • Auth（M0-011）— 自研 env → keyring → 0600 文件的解析与回退；用 OS keyring。学会：解释密钥为什么不能进日志，以及 keyring 失败时如何安全降级。
  • Safety（M1-002）— 自研策略与审批链；用 landlock/seccomp 或 bubblewrap。学会：演示一次拒绝写入/联网。
  • Clients（M0-004 / M1-001 / M1.5）— 自研 CLI 命令和事件到视图的映射；用 clap / ratatui。学会：同一事件流渲染两种界面。
  • Observability（M2-002）— 自研 usage 事件、metrics JSONL。学会：定位一次慢 turn。
  • Evaluation（M0-009）— 自研 scripted provider、fixture、golden transcript。学会：同一输入两次回放行为一致。

自研 / 用库的边界

判断标准：“这部分决定 agent 的行为质量吗？”

  • 决定 → 自己写：loop、context、tool protocol、event log、approval、eval。
  • 不决定 → 用库：HTTP、async runtime、CLI 解析、TUI 渲染、diff、glob、Markdown。
  • 安全 → 策略自己写，OS 原语用库；不要手写 syscall。

顺序

M0   CLI 骨架 / 事件日志 / auth / dashboard / minimal exec
     └─ M0-005 provider（scripted + OpenAI-compatible SSE）
     └─ M0-006 文件工具
     └─ M0-007 bash（超时、进程组、输出预算）
     └─ M0-008 loop + niucode exec（SessionRuntime 边界）
     └─ M0-009 resume + fixture
M1   TUI / approval / sandbox / diff
M1.5 只读 Web Session Viewer（JSONL → turn/tool/diff）
M2   compaction / AGENTS.md / cache 指标 / Runs 视图
M3   replay / fork / subagent（视需要）

每个阶段都必须能离线测试，不能依赖真实 API 才能验证 loop。

学习检查点

下一阶段 M7 先建立公开证据：八个自建小仓库、四个外部 Polyglot 任务、 同一 DeepSeek 的四方双轨基线。先依据真实失败分类安排修复，再扩展任务难度和重复数。 详见 公开评测计划。M6 仍是 active 阶段，真实终端与压力测试继续独立验收。

完成一个阶段时，应该能回答：

  • Provider：SSE 的 delta 如何合并成一条 assistant message？什么错误可以在 turn 边界重试，什么不能？
  • Tools：工具输出如何截断？read-before-write 为什么必须是策略而不是提示词？两个写工具并发会发生什么？
  • Loop：取消发生在 provider 流、工具执行、日志写入三个位置时，分别怎么处理？
  • Eval：如何在不烧 token 的情况下复现一个 turn？回放和真实调用差在哪？
  • Sandbox：路径校验、shell 隔离、网络关闭分别能防住什么，防不住什么？
  • Context：压缩后模型看到的历史和日志里的历史为什么可以不同？cache 前缀为什么不能随手改？
  • Observability：一个 turn 变慢时，如何区分模型、工具和 harness 自身？

M0 完成定义

  • niucode exec "<task>" 能在真实 repo 里完成一个小修改并跑测试。
  • session 可 resume；坏尾行不丢历史。
  • 工具有输出上限；bash 能超时杀进程组。
  • 至少一个 scripted provider 的离线回归测试。
  • cargo xtask dashboard --check 通过，架构图和 ADR 反映当前实现。

明确后置

MCP、插件系统、多 provider 全家桶、长期记忆、调度器、多人协作、Web 编辑架构图。等出现真实需求，再写 ADR。

docs.title: M6：可靠的终端结对编码实施计划
docs.summary: M6 结对闭环与第二阶段升级计划：纠正变更误报、限制主屏噪声、统一呈现、控制证据开销，以及真实终端验收。
docs.body_html:
状态与目标

2026-10-21：用户已确认产品方向和完整日常结对闭环的范围，并要求代码 robust、clean，不引入 dirty hack。共享编辑、运行时输入、审批/取消、历史详情、文件版本冲突与任务证据已实现，进入 review。M6 为 active；M5 的 inline review 和 Ghostty blocked 状态保持，实机矩阵及慢终端长时间压力验收未完成。

目标：用户能在原生终端里持续输入、观察、纠偏、取消和审阅 agent 的工作，界面状态与实际执行记录一致。真实编码任务评测集另立后续里程碑；本轮包含功能回归和真实终端交互验收。

第二阶段：从 hello 刷屏故障到可持续结对

2026-10-21：用户在最新版本地 TUI 中输入 hello，回答之后出现大量文件清单。 以下保留故障诊断与实施验收契约。用户随后授权全部实施；实现与测试进展见 TUI 升级验证，真实终端门槛继续独立跟踪。 原 M6 实机门槛继续有效，M6-010 文本布局完成不代表信息层次和审阅语义已通过验收。

已确认的问题

本地复现依据为会话 1792569929010-3258034-0.jsonl，只记录汇总， 不把含工作区文件正文的会话复制进公开测试或 benchmark。

观察根因及影响
hello 没有工具调用；前后快照各 394 个条目，条目完全相同264 个条目有 digest，130 个无 digest；相同的未知条目不能证明文件变化，也不能证明内容未变
130 条文件清单被打印为 workspace change · origin unknownchanges.rs::task_review 只跳过 digest 非空且相等的条目；其余直接进入变化列表，把覆盖不全误当成变化
完成后仍不断输出，结尾有两次成功信息live.rs 打印全部 review.summary，随后 tui.rs 再打印 done；详情还重复拼接 summary 和 detail
问候后提示 No recorded command checks; unverified.检查数为零时无条件生成提示，把没有执行检查和需要验证的修改混为一谈
单次问候日志 8,568,094 字节两份快照各带 3,789,249 字节文件正文；无工具对话也承担完整采集与序列化开销

目前 MAX_BYTES 为 4 MiB，预算不足的文件留下无 digest 条目。 测试覆盖了大文件快照不完整，却没有覆盖“两份相同的不完整快照进入任务审阅”， 也没有从 TUI 的最终输出断言系统消息的数量。这是需要补齐的验收缺口。

目标体验与信息层次

默认界面保留原生 scrollback。主屏优先显示用户消息、模型回答、需要行动的异常； 运行状态留在活动区，已记录的详细证据从 Ctrl-O 打开。建议效果如下，耗时仅为示意：

交付顺序与代码边界

顺序卡片交付与删除点
P0 / 1M6-011 纠正审阅语义agent 投影区分已证实变化、可比较且未变、无法确认；覆盖不足独立记录。删除“未跳过即变化”的判定；已证实变化的归属另行判断
P0 / 2M6-012 主屏收敛修正收尾和启动信息层次，工具进度有界，完整记录进入详情；删除 live/tui 双重完成输出和无条件检查警告
P1 / 3M6-013 呈现所有权agent 提供结构化审阅事实，CLI 统一决定文案与布局；主屏和详情消费同一投影，删除重复 summary/detail 文案拼装及视图冗余状态
P1 / 4M6-014 证据采集成本单独测量扫描、哈希、正文保存、序列化与回放成本，选择保留任务起点语义的正文去重方案；删除不必要的重复正文写入
P1 / 5M6-015 输出与负载验收建立可重放的输出预算与长期负载场景；汇总前面每卡的回归，并将真实终端复验交给 M6-009

011 → 012 为第一次可试用交付；013、014 随后分别收敛呈现和采集。 015 的 fixture 和测量从 011 开始积累，不等重构完成再补测试。 每次可试用交付记录源码状态及产物 hash，检查 PATH 实际命中的二进制，再提供体验步骤。

实现约束：

  • niucode-agent 判断证据，不持有终端行宽、颜色或控件；结构化投影可在 011 引入必要部分，013 收敛全部消费者。
  • CLI 沿用 Composer、text_layout、TerminalSession、runtime 命令/事件；一种状态只有一个呈现责任点，不新增通用 UI 框架或第二个事件循环。
  • 详情/审批状态收敛时保留草稿、选择和滚动位置；Esc、Ctrl-C、resize、运行中消息遵守现有边界。批准与普通键入不能混淆。
  • 事件日志仍是唯一持久事实。014 比较“引用已有事件正文”与“仅保存必要正文”等方案，明确历史 diff 覆盖及旧日志兼容；不先建外部快照数据库。
  • 任务开始基线不得悄悄挪到首次写入。若改变持久字段或覆盖契约，实施前单独记录 ADR 和 decision 事件；此计划没有批准替换 ADR-0028。
  • 保留 linear fallback；没有实机证据不切换默认渲染模式。

场景必须验证
hello + 脏仓库 + 130 个未知条目0 个被证实变化、130 个覆盖未知；无工具的事实保留，主屏只有一次收尾，不打印逐文件误报

原有 staged/unstaged/untracked + 工具写入 + 外部修改起点为任务开始，真实外部变化可见但不归因 agent；index 不变；回放结论一致
1 / 100 / 1000 个变化文件，超长命令及路径系统收尾行数不随规模增长；详情能定位全部已记录结果；正文不受摘要预算影响
无修改、修改无检查、检查非零、检查后继续修改检查缺失/失败/过期分别显示；普通命令退出 0 不冒充整体验收通过
输出 length、网络错误、冲突、取消、日志写入失败不显示正常完成；保留已记录内容、可行动原因和审阅入口，不丢失失败原因

100 轮无变化对话及 30 分钟慢输出记录每轮日志增量、常驻内存、采集/回放时延及取消时延；输出队列有界

014 的初始性能验收目标：固定 394 文件 fixture，首次建立基线后，后续无变化轮次 的证据字节增量比现状降低至少 90%；另列首次采集成本，不用预热数字代替。 同机同 fixture 报告中位数/P95；100 轮后正常受控等待的 Ctrl-C 到停止输出 P95 不超过 250ms（不含操作系统不可中断 I/O）。实施结果已记录在 TUI 第二阶段验证：证据增量下降 98.81%，任务结束 P95 124.9ms；输入框恢复 P95 350.28ms 独立报告。

测试使用 synthetic repo、scripted provider 与本地 PTY，不依赖付费模型或私人会话正文。 除了现有 workspace/fmt/clippy/dashboard 检查，断言应落在公开行为：屏幕行数、 任务结果、日志回放和 index 保留，而不是只检查新增类型或 ANSI 字符串。 真实 Linux/macOS、IME、复制、scrollback 与 tmux 继续由 M6-009 留证，PTY 不替代实机。

benchmarks/evidence/2026-10-21-v1/ 与 2026-10-21-truncation-fix/ 保持不变； TUI 输出预算是独立交互回归，不能拿新表现回填原有模型 benchmark 成绩。

1. 统一编辑与终端呈现

编辑行为

  • Enter 提交；Ctrl-J 始终换行；终端能区分 Shift-Enter 时同样换行。无法区分的键不能靠终端品牌猜测。
  • Bracketed paste 保留换行，CRLF 规范化一次；粘贴内容中的 Enter、slash 和控制字符不能触发提交或本地命令。异常超大输入明确提示预算，不静默截断。
  • 光标与删除以字素簇为单位；显示宽度与字素分段分开处理。优先使用专门库，不手写 Unicode 分段规则。
  • 软换行和可视区滚动共享一个布局结果；上下移动保留目标列，首尾边界才切换历史；返回历史末端恢复未提交草稿。
  • 撤销/重做、单词移动/删除、Home/End、历史搜索有一致语义；撤销一次粘贴恢复粘贴前状态。
  • 补全基于光标处 token，候选可滚动，选择项始终可见；路径发现复用 ignore 规则，尊重嵌套 .gitignore；大仓库发现可取消，不阻塞按键循环。
  • 草稿在当前进程内跨审批、详情窗口和取消保留。跨重启草稿恢复不是本轮承诺；不新增 draft.json。

渲染与终端所有权

  • 主 transcript 只追加；输入、状态、候选属于一个受控活动区。临时详情/审批可进入 alternate screen，退出恢复输入与原生 scrollback。
  • 只有 terminal owner 可以读取终端事件、设置模式和写交互终端。运行时、observer 和后台任务发送数据，不能自行 println/eprintln。
  • 正文按稳定块增量输出；基本标题、列表、代码块和 diff 可读，控制序列统一清洗。已进入 scrollback 的历史不反复擦写来实现折叠。
  • 输入、审批、详情视图是显式状态转换。守卫恢复的是进入前状态，避免嵌套 guard 退出时错误关闭仍需要的 raw/mouse/paste 模式。
  • 读取事件可取消、线程/任务可 join；禁止遗留永久阻塞的 event::read 线程。绘制合并与背压有界，慢终端不能阻塞取消或无限积累 token delta。
  • 光标查询有超时，查询响应与用户输入分流，失败时不吞键；能力检测集中，遵守 TERM/NO_COLOR/非 TTY。
  • 降级共享编辑语义；不增加按终端名字复制的 editor。现有 Ghostty fallback 仅在真实回归证据通过后移除。
  • 详情阅读期间继续接收运行事件；仅主屏暂停呈现，退出后有序输出积累内容。积累有预算，超出时从日志重建；取消不等待详情关闭。

2. SessionRuntime 与运行中纠偏

落地 ADR-0004 的进程内 Command/Event 边界，保留 exec/JSON 的既有语义。实现先明确状态转移，再接 UI，禁止通过共享可变 history、轮询文件或克隆 SessionLog writer 打补丁。

生命周期

输入/事件行为
空闲提交创建一个用户任务执行区间，日志记录开始边界，开始请求
运行中普通提交原文和稳定消息 ID 先记日志，标记待接收
安全请求边界当前 assistant 的 tool calls 都有结果（包括拒绝/取消）；按序注入补充，再构建下一请求
已接收标记消息已纳入发起的请求，不表示模型已遵守，也不声称上游恰好收到一次
显式排队独立任务按 FIFO 等当前任务结束；排队文本不提前影响当前任务上下文
当前响应准备结束时收到补充runtime 按命令顺序处理已接受消息，再决定结束或继续；不丢失尾部消息
审批使用 request/call ID 关联，等待期间仍处理输入与取消；旧/重复答复不授权新操作
取消停止当前请求/工具/子任务，清理进程组，保留已完成事实与草稿；待处理消息保持可见
恢复会话从事件恢复待处理消息和执行状态；显示中断结果未知的调用，不自动重放有副作用的操作
  • “用户任务”覆盖多次模型请求；不要重新解释现有 TurnEnd（目前每次响应记录 usage）的含义。新增任务边界只解决归属与恢复。
  • 单一 runtime 拥有日志追加；在 provider、工具、审批等待期间也能接收控制命令。I/O future 返回结果供 runtime 追加事件，不与第二个 writer 竞争。
  • 临时输入队列有上限；只有日志追加成功才能确认接受。重试和 reconnect 使用消息 ID 去重，不承诺模型请求 exactly-once。
  • 队列、接收标记、任务结束/取消是日志事实；history、状态栏、队列列表是投影。游标、选择、刷新节流不落日志。
  • 请求失败后补充保留在上下文，可随显式继续再次提交；恢复后的独立排队任务需要用户继续才执行，replay/fork 不执行工具。
  • 模型、权限和会话切换仍按既有安全边界处理；运行中会话切换不偷偷迁移消息或扩大权限。审批时输入普通文字不自动代表允许。
  • 取消不等于撤销文件改动；中途写入或日志追加失败时用“结果未知”呈现，不能补造成功，也不能自动重复执行。
  • 新事件向后兼容读取旧日志；新语义由集中 projection 解释。增加字段有默认值，禁止不同消费者各自写一套队列恢复算法。

3. 并发编辑与审阅证据

文件修改

  • 将 observed 路径集合升级为内容版本观测；不能仅依赖 mtime/文件大小。部分 read 不自动授权覆盖未展示的全部内容，明确 edit 与整文件 write 的前置条件。
  • 为 write/edit 建立共享的 prepare/validate/apply 路径，预览与实际应用绑定同一旧内容/目标版本。审批后版本变化使该预览失效，需要重新读取与重新决策。
  • 对新建、删除重建、重命名、symlink 目标变化、外部原地写入分别校验；不把目标突然不存在当作已获授权的新建文件。
  • 写入错误不能静默截断旧文件；替换过程处理权限、可执行位、清理和失败恢复。逐平台测试支持的替换语义，不把 atomic rename 误写成跨编辑器的原子 compare-and-swap。
  • 保留父/Worker 的写串行约束；内部锁不约束外部编辑器。共享工作区方案是乐观冲突检测，最终检查与写入之间的外部竞争仍有残余窗口。
  • bash/扩展不是文件工具版本检查的例外实现，也不能被包装成具有相同保证。操作前后采集变化证据，发现冲突暂停后续受影响写入；不自动回滚用户修改。文件 watcher 只能提示变化，不能证明来源。
  • 审计写入发生但结果未记日志的崩溃窗口；缺少证据则标记未知，不能推断文件当前状态就是 agent 成功执行的结果。

本轮基线与累计 diff

  • 基线在用户任务开始、第一次工具副作用前采集，使用当时磁盘内容；不能用 HEAD 或 staged diff 代替，也不修改用户 index、stash 或已有未提交内容。
  • 基线覆盖 tracked 与非忽略 untracked，记录内容、存在性和必要元数据；非 Git 仓库显式使用受预算约束的文件清单，不能宣称完整仓库覆盖。
  • 基线扫描和内容读取有字节/文件/时间预算，可取消；对超限、二进制、忽略路径、大文件和扫描期间发生变化的文件显示覆盖范围/未知，不给虚假的完整 diff。
  • shell 的写集合事先未知，任务开始基线用来识别最终净变化；文件工具操作记录用于补充因果证据。工作区净变化不自动等于 agent 改动。
  • 持久审阅事实通过事件记录受预算约束的基线内容/变化与覆盖范围；缓存仅为可删除的派生加速。若完整内容未记录或超限，恢复后相应 diff 明确不可重建，不依赖隐藏 snapshot 数据库。
  • 取消/失败后同样能审阅已记录改动。本轮内反复编辑显示最终净差异，并可定位操作记录；未知外部修改单独标识，不混入 agent 成果摘要。

验证结果

  • 工具执行状态与命令退出状态分开：正常退出码、信号、超时、取消、基础设施错误均结构化记录。保持 tool call ID 关联；旧 ToolResult.ok 不静默改变语义。
  • 界面“命令退出 0”仅证明该命令成功退出；只有明确选定的验收命令才能标为对应检查通过，不从任意 shell 文本或模型自述猜测测试成功。
  • 每条验证证据关联命令、工作目录、call ID、任务与发生顺序。检查之后又修改相关工作区时标记结果可能过期，不能继续显示最终版本已验证。
  • 完成卡分别显示修改文件、已执行检查、失败/未验证项与未知变化。无工具 evaluator 的 met 不是检查通过证据；本轮不扩展自主 goal 调度能力。

交付卡与依赖

卡片状态起点交付内容依赖
M6-001done已确认契约、ADR、实施计划与看板—
M6-002ready共用编辑状态、布局、补全和输入回归M6-001
M6-003backlog单一终端所有者与受控活动区M6-002
M6-004ready事件驱动 SessionRuntime、审批与取消M6-001
M6-005backlog运行中补充/排队、接收状态与草稿恢复M6-003、M6-004
M6-006backlogreasoning/历史工具详情与稳定输出层次M6-003、M6-004
M6-007ready文件版本观测、预览失效与冲突检测M6-001
M6-008backlog任务基线、累计 diff、结构化验证汇总M6-004、M6-006、M6-007
M6-009backlogLinux/macOS 真实终端矩阵与发布验收M6-005、M6-006、M6-008

实施顺序建议：002 → 003 → 004 → 005 → 006 → 007 → 008 → 009。每卡必须从界面或公开调用入口验证完整行为，不能以新增类型、空 handler 或只接通演示路径标 done。009 的测试场景从 002 开始建立，不能最后才测试终端。

验证与发布门槛

层次必测场景证据
编辑模型CJK、组合字符、emoji/ZWJ、CRLF、多行粘贴、撤销、长行、草稿/历史、候选滚动公共编辑入口的行为断言，随机动作序列不变量
布局/状态窄窗口、零/极小尺寸、resize、长代码、嵌套详情/审批、模式退出确定性布局/快照测试；光标在有效范围；文本文字完整
Runtimeprovider/tool/approval 阻塞时补充与取消、最后响应竞态、队列满、日志写入失败、resume/fork/compactscripted provider、受控时钟/屏障、真实日志回放；不用固定 sleep 碰运气
文件/证据等长修改、删除重建、symlink、预览后变化、权限、磁盘错误、脏仓库、untracked、外部修改、检查后再编辑临时目录与 Git fixture；未知状态不报成功；用户 index 不变
PTY按键/粘贴/resize 与流式输出交错、审批取消、进程组退出、终端模式恢复输入脚本、终端状态断言、屏幕捕获；禁止只断言 ANSI 字符串存在
实机终端自然复制、IME 输入、scrollback、tmux 鼠标、字体宽度、模式恢复、长时间输出OS/终端/tmux/字体/尺寸/配置/commit、步骤、截图或录屏、pass/fail 与问题链接

每卡运行仓库要求：cargo test --workspace、cargo fmt --all --check、cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings、cargo xtask dashboard、cargo xtask dashboard --check。修改哪个行为就补哪个失败路径回归，不复制实现写镜像测试，不靠全局 allow/ignore 隐藏失败。

实机矩阵

OS必验终端模式本计划的验证状态
LinuxGhostty、Kitty、WezTerm、GNOME Terminal各自直连 / tmux未验证
macOSGhostty、Kitty、WezTerm、Terminal.app各自直连 / tmux未验证

选择 GNOME Terminal 与 Terminal.app 作为“代表性系统终端”的初始可执行范围。支持声明绑定实际记录的版本，不泛称所有版本兼容。每个组合至少覆盖窄/宽窗口、缩放、中文与多行粘贴、流式输出、补充/取消、审批/详情、滚动与复制；另外覆盖无颜色、能力查询超时与非 TTY。

CI 增加 Linux/macOS 的可运行测试。macOS 缺少 Linux bwrap 时不能偷偷降级权限来让测试变绿：UI 使用 scripted provider/受控 fixture，Linux 专属沙箱测试按能力明确隔离，产品的 sandbox/backend 支持单独标明。

没有真实 macOS 或图形终端时，相关验收保持未验证并注明缺少的环境；完成独立实现不等于 M6 发布完成。M5-003/M5-006 的原验收要求用真实证据关闭，不能靠换卡片 ID 消失。

Robust / clean 的审查门槛

  1. 同一个编辑/候选/恢复规则只有一个实现；迁移时写清旧路径的删除点，002/003 完成后不长期维护两套编辑内核。
  2. 终端品牌特判、新增环境开关、固定延迟、吞错误、全局可变状态都不是默认修复手段。兼容例外必须有最小复现、适用范围、回归用例与移除条件。
  3. 事件写入、终端恢复、任务取消、线程回收的错误路径有明确所有者；不依靠 Drop 中不可观测的修补来伪造成功。
  4. 所有异步等待可取消；输入、输出和工具结果队列有界；不持有会阻塞 UI 控制的锁等待人工审批。
  5. 每次重构保持已有 CLI/JSON、权限、resume/fork/compaction 行为有回归证据。只因新功能需要而扩大 core，且在 ADR 中说明持久语义。
  6. 默认切换必须同时包含调用方迁移、旧逻辑删除、文档和验证。测试通过后再扩展下一阶段，不能把多个未验证子系统一次性替换。
  7. 不通过 mock 全部 I/O 来证明终端可靠；逻辑测试、PTY 和真实终端各证明自己的范围。
  8. 每张实现卡评审最终 diff：重复状态是否消失、边界是否更小、失败是否可解释、取消是否完整、未知事实是否被错误美化。

后续与范围控制

后续独立里程碑：真实任务成功率/人工纠偏次数/时延与成本评测、长上下文质量、无人值守 goal 的独立证据验证。本轮不引入 Windows 一等支持、常驻全屏桌面、自动合并用户改动或通用多代理调度器。

架构决策见 ADR-0028；各卡片的验收是执行依据。本计划不以缺少真实终端环境为由跳过可独立完成的实现，也不把未验证的平台承诺写成 done。

docs.title: ADR-0001：Rust 作为核心语言
docs.summary: 性能优先不等于 loop 快几毫秒；Rust 换来的是启动、内存、分发和原生沙箱。
docs.body_html:
状态

Accepted · 2026-10-20

背景

niucode 是一个单二进制 CLI：长会话、流式子进程、沙箱、可能的多子代理。语言选型要在两端做取舍：

  • 运行时：harness 自身耗时（SSE 解析、JSON、日志、调度）通常只占一个 turn 的 1–5ms，而模型 TTFT + 生成是 1–3s。换语言不会让 agent 明显变快。
  • 工程形态：冷启动、常驻内存、单二进制分发、进程组/信号控制、原生沙箱，这些是 Rust 的真实优势。
  • 开发迭代：Rust 的编译反馈和 async 设计摩擦，会让早期功能吞吐慢 1.5–2x；这是"写功能慢"，不是"运行时慢"。

决策

核心使用 Rust，workspace 拆分小 crate：

crates/
  niucode-core/       # 事件、会话、loop、context
  niucode-cli/        # 参数与生命周期
  niucode-provider/   # 后续：wire adapters
  niucode-tools/      # 后续：工具
  niucode-sandbox/    # 后续：策略与平台隔离
  xtask/         # 仓库工具（看板构建）

后果

正向

  • 单静态二进制，启动 2–10ms，无 runtime 依赖。
  • 常驻内存低，多 session / 子代理时线性成本可控。
  • 进程组、超时、信号、fd 管理语义明确，取消链路可靠。
  • landlock / seccomp / seatbelt 可直接调用，不需要 native addon 或外部包装进程。
  • 事件、状态机、工具 schema 适合强类型，后期重构成本低。

负向

  • 编译反馈比 TS 慢一个数量级。
  • async 流式状态机在接口未定型时摩擦大。
  • OpenAI / Anthropic 的 Rust SDK 不如 TS/Python 成熟，SSE 和事件映射要自己写。
  • TUI 迭代比 Ink/React 慢。

缓解

  1. workspace 拆小 crate，niucode-core 不依赖 CLI / TUI，增量编译范围小。
  2. bacon / cargo-watch + cargo check 作为内循环；链接器用 mold/lld。
  3. 控制 proc-macro 依赖，provider 边界允许 serde_json::Value，内部强类型。
  4. headless first，TUI last；loop / tools 用 scripted provider 离线测试。
  5. context 逻辑写成纯函数 + fixture，改 prompt 策略不需要重编译整个 workspace。

备选方案

  • TypeScript / Bun：迭代最快，官方 SDK 最全，TUI 生态好。运行时足够，但单二进制、内存和原生沙箱弱。若接下来数周的主要目标是高频试 context 策略，这是更快的选择。
  • Rust core + TS TUI（JSON-RPC）：长期可行，但 v0 多一套协议、进程生命周期和错误映射，违背 minimal。等事件协议稳定后再考虑拆分。
  • Python：原型最快，但分发、并发、类型约束和长会话内存都不占优。

备注

"Rust 慢一倍"指的是开发迭代速度，不是运行时。性能优先应当优化 prompt cache、工具输出体积、并行工具和 compaction，而不是期待换语言让模型响应变快。

docs.title: ADR-0002：事件日志是唯一真相
docs.summary: 内存状态只是 JSONL 日志的 fold；resume、fork、replay 和 compaction 都从日志派生。
docs.body_html:
状态

Accepted · 2026-10-20

背景

Agent 进程会崩溃、被取消、被重启。如果对话只存在内存里，一次崩溃就丢掉全部上下文；如果另外维护一份"session 快照"，它和内存状态迟早不一致。

决策

每个 session 是一个 append-only JSONL 文件，一行一个 Event。内存状态是日志的 fold：

state = fold(events)
  • 写入：SessionLog::append 序列化一行、flush，不改旧行。
  • 读取：load 逐行解码；坏行变成 warning，不丢整份历史。
  • 恢复：resume 从日志重建，而不是从快照恢复。
  • 分叉：fork 复制某个前缀，生成新 session。
  • 压缩：compaction 事件记录摘要和 upto；只影响投影，不删原始事件。

后果

正向

  • resume / replay / fork 共用一套机制，测试可离线回放。
  • 崩溃最多丢最后一行（未 flush），不会出现"内存与磁盘不一致"。
  • 审计简单：每个决策、工具调用、usage 都有时间线。
  • 压缩是投影变换，可回滚、可对比。

负向

  • 日志会增长；长会话需要 compaction 和归档策略。
  • 事件 schema 演进需要兼容策略（新增字段可默认，删除/改义要迁移）。
  • 日志可能包含敏感内容（文件内容、命令输出），需要权限和清理策略。
  • 每次 append 都 flush，吞吐低于批量写；对 agent 的写入频率足够。

投影规则

  1. 原始事件永远保留。
  2. 最后一个 compaction 的 upto 之前的事件不进入模型上下文，替换为摘要；upto 是绝对事件下标，精确语义见 ADR-0008。
  3. tool_result 必须和对应 assistant_message.tool_calls 成对出现；日志里缺失 result（例如取消）时，投影补一条 cancelled tool result。
  4. reasoning 是否进入上下文由 provider 适配层决定，日志始终保留原文。
  5. 投影是纯函数：相同日志 + 相同预算 → 相同上下文。

备选方案

  • 内存 messages + 退出时快照：实现简单，但崩溃丢上下文，且快照与内存双真相。
  • 数据库（SQLite）：查询和并发更好，但 v0 引入 schema、迁移和依赖；JSONL 可 grep、可 diff、可直接回放。
  • 只存模型可见的投影：省空间，但丢掉审计和 fork 能力，压缩不可逆。

风险与缓解

  • 日志过大：按 session 归档，支持 compact --archive；看板 Runs 视图只读聚合指标。
  • 敏感信息：session 目录默认 0700；提供 niucode session redact 的后续入口。
  • 坏行：加载时 warning + 行号；--strict 模式用于 CI。

docs.title: ADR-0003：Dashboard 以架构为第一屏
docs.summary: 看板不再以进度为主叙事；默认 Architecture，Work 降为二级，进度装饰从架构视图移除。
docs.body_html:
状态

Accepted · 2026-10-20

背景

项目看板最初照搬了任务看板的默认视图：打开就是 Board、里程碑进度条、完成率和卡片计数。这个结构回答的是"做到哪了"，但项目真正需要反复阅读的是"系统由哪些边界组成、依赖往哪流、为什么这样切"。

进度信息还有两个问题：它和 git、session log 重复；为了看起来完整，会诱导维护者不断更新百分比和统计数字，而不是更新架构和决策。卡片本身仍然是 agent 的 handoff 面，值得保留，但不应该占据第一屏。

决策

  1. 默认视图改为 Architecture，导航固定为 Architecture / Work / Docs / Decisions。
  2. Work 降为二级视图：保留卡片、状态列和里程碑筛选，但移除进度条、完成率、WIP 数字和卡片计数。
  3. Architecture 只保留结构信息：层、模块、关系、owned paths、contract、源码；planned / active / done 是模块状态，不是完成率。
  4. Decisions 只收决策：ADR 和 kind = "decision" 事件；不展示"某张卡完成"的流水账。
  5. 不上前端框架：继续原生 JS/CSS，保持单文件、离线、cargo xtask dashboard 确定性构建。
  6. 视觉方向为 technical field guide：暖纸、墨色、深绿强调、低饱和层色；架构图是主角；不做 zoom/pan 和拖拽编辑。

后果

正向

  • 第一屏直接回答"系统长什么样"，而不是"完成了几张卡"。
  • 进度回到 git / session log / Work 视图，减少看板变成第二真相源的压力。
  • 单文件、零构建、离线可用；页面大约维持在当前体量。
  • 模块聚焦会弱化无关节点，复杂架构图仍然可读。

负向

  • 想快速看进度的人需要多点一次 Work。
  • 卡片状态仍然需要维护；只是不再用进度条装饰它。
  • 没有 zoom/pan，超过约 30 个模块后需要重新评估图导航。

备选方案

  • 保留 Board 优先：改动最小，但与架构阅读的目标冲突。
  • 删除 Work，进度交给 GitHub Issues：最纯粹，但会破坏当前 AGENTS.md 依赖卡片做 handoff 的流程，并引入第二套状态源。
  • 引入 React/Svelte + 图编辑器：当前 9 个模块、8 条关系，框架 runtime 比数据还大；等真的需要编辑/拖拽/多人协作时再做。

Revisit 条件

出现以下任一情况时重新评估：

  1. 模块数量超过 30，或关系超过 60，当前分层图不可读。
  2. 需要在浏览器里编辑架构或卡片，而不只是阅读。
  3. 出现多个并发读者/写者，需要真正的服务端状态。
