docs.title: ADR-0028：原生终端结对与可验证交付
docs.summary: M6 采用统一编辑/终端所有权、Command/Event runtime、默认收起 reasoning、共享工作区冲突检测与证据审阅；发布需 Linux/macOS 实机验收。
docs.body_html:
状态

Accepted · 2026-10-21 · 用户已确认产品契约；实现计划见 docs/pairing-upgrade.md。Accepted 表示决策被接受，不表示 M6 已实现或跨终端验证通过。

背景

niucode 的目标是日常结对编码。当前两套 editor 的输入行为不一致；TUI 执行期间没有输入通道；read-before-write 只检查读过的路径；工具调用成功不等于命令退出成功。用户要求系统性升级，并明确要求 robust、clean，不接受 dirty hack。

决策

  1. 终端原生交互。 主 transcript 使用原生 scrollback，保留选择复制与终端搜索；活动输入区统一管理。临时详情与审批可以使用 alternate screen，不引入常驻全屏应用。
  2. 单一编辑与终端所有者。 编辑状态、Unicode 布局与补全共享；终端能力适配只负责实际差异。所有交互输出和终端事件读取集中管理，禁止后台直接打印和品牌分叉的编辑器。
  3. 落实 ADR-0004 的 Command/Event 边界。 runtime 位于 agent，拥有唯一会话日志 writer；TUI/CLI 发送命令、消费事件。UI 不调用 loop 内部，不维护第二份可持久会话状态。
  4. 运行中 Enter 补充当前任务。 补充先落日志，再在安全的下一请求边界注入；待接收/已接收有明确语义。排队任务使用显式动作，取消保留已完成事实和当前草稿。
  5. Reasoning 默认收起。 主屏显示状态、耗时与实际进展；已记录 reasoning 通过详情访问。M6-006 已切换默认行为，替代 ADR-0021 的第 3–5 条默认展示策略。中断流未完整落盘时不得声称可恢复全部 reasoning。
  6. 共享工作区是默认方式。 对文件工具实现内容版本与预览失效检测；外部编辑和任意 shell 写入不受内部写锁完全约束。采用乐观检测，明确残余竞争窗口；未知来源不自动归因，不自动回滚用户变化。
  7. 审阅来自实际证据。 即时简报加本轮累计 diff，以任务开始工作区为基线；保持原有未提交内容和 index。结构化记录检查退出状态，区分成功、失败、取消、未知/未验证；后续修改使先前验证可能过期。
  8. 持久事实仍在日志。 接收/排队/任务边界、受预算约束的审阅事实属于事件；缓存可删除，超预算的内容明确不可完整重建。布局、刷新、未提交草稿是临时状态。core 仅增加必要的持久类型。
  9. Linux/macOS 都是验收平台。 Ghostty、Kitty、WezTerm、代表性系统终端及其 tmux 组合记录具体版本和测试证据。TUI 支持不等于跨平台沙箱已实现，禁止为了通过 UI 测试静默放宽权限。
  10. 渐进迁移。 每阶段保持可用、可回归；旧实现有删除门槛。既有 Ghostty fallback 遵循 ADR-0022，在真实回归通过前不移除；不得用新增特判长期掩盖架构缺陷。

后果

  • 运行中输入需要重整执行/审批生命周期，不能仅更换 widget。
  • 新增持久事件需覆盖旧日志、projection、resume、fork 与 JSON 兼容；不重新解释已有 TurnEnd/ToolResult.ok。
  • 共享工作区保留即时反馈，但不提供对任意外部程序的事务隔离或 exactly-once 执行保证。
  • 实机矩阵是发布门槛；自动化测试通过不能代替真实终端证据。
  • 不新增通用框架、daemon、前端插件系统或 Windows 本轮支持；真实编码任务评测另立后续里程碑。

关联

  • 延续 ADR-0002、0004、0019 的日志、会话和原生终端边界。
  • M6-006 落地时更新 ADR-0021 的展示策略状态；其输入区紧凑原则继续适用。
  • ADR-0022 的 Ghostty gate 和 M5-006 保持有效，直至同一真实验收证据满足。

实现记录 · 2026-10-21

  • Composer/Completion 只管输入状态；TerminalSession/DetailScreen 管模式与呈现，live 是活动 TUI 的唯一事件循环。删除独立 inline editor。
  • crossterm 统一到 0.29，避免两版本各持有输入/模式状态；使用 level-triggered use-dev-tty 输入后端与正超时有界轮询。PTY 覆盖 resize 与按键同时到达，无终端品牌特判。
  • SessionLog 保留一个 writer，内部 Mutex 串行化完整 append；首个 I/O 失败后禁用 writer，不重试可能部分写入的事件。新增输入、任务与证据事件，core 不依赖任何 UI/执行组件。
  • prepare/preview/apply 使用同一不可变修改对象，W1 在审批后获取；命令证据快照在释放 W1 前采集。外部编辑的最终校验/替换竞态仍存在。
  • 回调式 headless 与通道式 TUI 复用同一引擎；旧 JSON / resume / compaction / subagent fixture 保持回归。真实终端矩阵、慢输出压力和跨平台结果单独记录，未宣称已通过。

交互补充 · 2026-10-21

用户要求模型/权限选择一次确认生效。TTY 的 /model / /permissions 进入参数菜单，打开不改配置，Enter 或点击选择后直接沿现有命令路径执行，Esc 取消，Tab 仅补全。此处更新 ADR-0015 的 TTY 裸命令展示行为；非 TTY 查询与事件/权限边界不变。输入/菜单焦点通过标准光标形状和可见性表示，退出恢复终端默认形状，不增加终端品牌判断。

文本布局收敛 · 2026-10-21

用户选择统一文本布局并继续删除重复实现。CLI 内的 text_layout 负责字素宽度、 换行、控制字符可视化、tab 和裁剪；Composer 保留编辑/历史状态，TerminalSession 保留终端所有权。输入与输出复用布局算法，只有输入生成位置映射并预留满行后的光标格。 静态输出不创建 Composer，不生成 undo/history，也不保存另一份会话状态。

输入、流式预览、inline transcript、详情和 diff 共享字素规则；linear transcript 继续交给终端原生软换行。tab 使用逻辑行上的四列制表位，不因软换行改变列宽。 输出换行函数按逻辑行限制 1 MiB 源文本，在字素边界保留前缀并显示 [display truncated]，不丢弃后续诊断行。显示标记不代表原始日志被截断，亦不承诺 未落盘内容可恢复。diff 继续拥有行号和 gutter，不引入通用 renderer 框架。
docs.excerpt: M6 采用统一编辑/终端所有权、Command/Event runtime、默认收起 reasoning、共享工作区冲突检测与证据审阅；发布需 Linux/macOS 实机验收。

docs.title: Releasing niucode crates
docs.summary: Version 0.1.6, publish order, and the license/token prerequisites for the public crates.
docs.body_html:
Version

All publishable crates share the workspace version 0.1.6. Treat them as one release: bump [workspace.package] version and publish the whole set together. niuse 0.1.12 depends on niucode-* = "0.1.6" while keeping path dependencies for local development.

Version 0.1.6 is the API niuse 0.1.12 packages against: it includes EmbedderTool, the TUI session seams, MCP mount audit, and the accepted ADR-0034 write path (write_tools, --allow-mcp-write). 0.1.5 on the registry predated those APIs even though the source had moved; the coordinated release fixes that version-discipline gap. It stays pre-1.0.

Prerequisites

  1. A license. MIT OR Apache-2.0 is set in [workspace.package], with LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE at the root. Every publishable crate inherits it.
  2. A verified crates.io email. crates.io rejects uploads from an account whose email is not verified, even with a valid token. Set it at https://crates.io/settings/profile.
  3. A crates.io token. cargo login, or set CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN in the environment. Never commit the token.
  4. A clean tree and green CI. Publish from a commit that passed the normal workflow; no --allow-dirty.

Publish order

Each crate must exist in the registry before its dependents can resolve it:

niucode-core
niucode-auth
niucode-provider
niucode-tools
niucode-extension
niucode-mcp
niucode-agent
niucode          (binary crate)

xtask and benchmarks/gateway are publish = false.

Commands

./scripts/publish-niucode.sh --check     # license/token/plan, no upload
./scripts/publish-niucode.sh --execute   # publish in order, waiting for the index

Or run the release workflow from Actions → Run workflow, type publish-niucode, and let it use the CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN repository secret. The crates-io environment can hold protection rules for that secret. The workflow runs the same script and refuses without a license or token.

The script checks crates.io before each upload and skips a crate whose version is already listed, so a failed run can be retried without already uploaded errors. A dry run of a dependent crate cannot succeed before its dependency is published: Cargo looks up niucode-core on crates.io. That is why the script checks the plan instead of pretending each crate can be dry-run locally.

Published

0.1.0 was published on 2026-10-22 in the order above. cargo install niucode --version 0.1.0 --locked was verified from a clean root.

niucode-mcp 0.1.5 was published on 2026-10-23 after the package and publish dry-runs. The other 0.1.5 crates were already on the registry and the script skipped them.

0.1.1 was the patch for the inline CJK spacing fix and TuiOptions. 0.1.2 added the full TUI hook surface; 0.1.3 added filter_text and the command hook; 0.1.4 added after_turn / on_answer; 0.1.5 adds command registration. The order is unchanged.

After publishing

  • Add version = "0.1.0" beside the path dependencies in niuse.
  • Bump niuse's niucode.rev to the release commit.
  • Verify cargo install niucode --version 0.1.0 in a clean directory.
  • Then niuse can be packaged and published on the same version.

If a release is wrong

Yank the affected version (cargo yank --version 0.1.0 <crate>) and publish 0.1.1; do not reuse a version.

Pre-release verification

Run these before bumping versions or publishing:

cargo fmt --all --check
cargo +1.88.0 check --workspace --all-targets
cargo test --workspace
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo package -p niucode --allow-dirty

The package tarball must include assets/web.html; the web approval path must not depend on unreleased derives from sibling crates.
docs.excerpt: Version 0.1.6, publish order, and the license/token prerequisites for the public crates.

docs.title: ADR-0029：公开、同模型的 harness 评测
docs.summary: 四方、双轨、独立评分；DeepSeek 首轮预算 300 元，M6 终端 gate 保持独立。
docs.body_html:
决策

Accepted · 2026-10-21。用户通过 grill-me 访谈确认： 日常已有项目修 bug、加小功能；同模型比较 niucode、mini-SWE-agent、DeepSeek Harness、Pi； 基础单 agent 与增强配置分轨；公开基准加自建简单案例；首轮 API 上限 ¥300。 完成标准是可信、可复现的基线，不要求 niucode 获胜。

  1. 评测设施属于 engineering，放在 benchmarks/，不进入 agent/core。
  2. 任务为公开的合成小仓库，注明来源、范围和限制。基础版本、需求、参考补丁、 独立验收、错误修复样例全部公开；自建题运行时不给 agent 评分测试与参考补丁。 外部 Polyglot 子集保留公开原始测试可见，参考解仍不进入运行工作区；单独报告协议差异。
  3. 每次运行使用全新隔离容器和工作区，只开放受限模型网关。评分另起无外网容器， 恢复原始测试与构建清单，只采纳候选源码。案例禁止新增外部依赖，需求须明确这一限制。
  4. 模型统一 deepseek-flash、thinking enabled、high、8192 输出上限。 框架保留原生提示词和工具协议；Messages/ChatCompletions 协议差异必须公开。 服务别名无法锁定底层快照，记录日期、请求和返回模型标识，交错运行配对任务。
  5. 基础轨关闭额外技能/插件/MCP/子 agent；增强轨提前冻结通用验证工作流及各框架可用的 原生/官方示例委派能力。增强轨不是“每家最优配置”，不得如此宣传。
  6. gateway 独立使用 niucode-auth 解析凭证。参赛容器只有本地占位凭证。 请求前以全上下文容量和输出上限预留高峰费用，最终 usage 结算保守上界； 无 usage、断连、超时、崩溃保留预留，日志损坏或写失败停止付费调用。
  7. 各 harness 的事件/轨迹仍是对应会话的唯一持久事实。 benchmark 的追加计费日志记录评测费用事实，不保存第二份可恢复会话或任务队列； 配置、patch、评分与报告是独立评测产物，不能驱动会话重放副作用。
  8. 成绩按任务集、轨道、版本分别报告。基础设施错误、超时、测试失败、未运行分开； 模型自评 met 和进程退出 0 都不能替代独立验收。公开分母、重复次数、费用和逐题结果。
  9. 无人工提示为自动评测主轨；日常运行中纠偏、恢复、终端实测另记，不由 headless 成绩代替。
  10. M6 保持 active，M7 作为 planned 的后续阶段先建设评测设施； 不以自动化 benchmark 关闭 M5/M6 真实终端 gate。

交付与限制

先用独立 dev 题调通适配，再冻结正式八题和外部公开基准实例。 任何正式题发生规格或评分修改，须改变任务集 hash 并作废受影响对比。 先跑小样本实测成本，再决定 ¥300 内重复数量。 八题只检验小范围代码修改，不代表大仓库、长上下文、多语言全面能力，也不是行业排行榜。 配置、案例与结果可公开交付；推送/发布到外部平台另按用户指令处理。
docs.excerpt: 四方、双轨、独立评分；DeepSeek 首轮预算 300 元，M6 终端 gate 保持独立。

docs.title: ADR-0030：生成截断不等于任务完成
docs.summary: 记录 finish_reason；length 复用现有错误路径，不执行截断调用、不自动续写。
docs.body_html:
决策

Accepted · 2026-10-21。用户要求修复输出截断却报告 done，保留原评测基线。

  1. Loop 保留 provider 的 finish_reason，写入 turn_end 的可选同名字段。 旧日志缺省为 None；TurnEnd 仍表示一次响应结束，不表示任务成功。 core 仅保存这一持久事实，不解释 provider 协议或增加任务状态存储。
  2. length 是不完整响应。消费本次流以收集最终 usage，记录已经收到的 text/reasoning 与 usage，然后返回明确错误。该响应的工具参数即使是完整 JSON 也不派发；不完整参数不经过 JSON 组装，不写成可执行的历史 tool_calls。 若需要原始 tool deltas，使用已有 --record provider fixture。
  3. 复用 runtime 的 task_finished.status=error，不发 TaskDone；CLI 输出 error 并非零退出，TUI 显示同一个错误。--goal evaluator 的 length 也不得产生 met。
  4. 不增加自动续写、重试配置或费用循环。已有已完成工具副作用保持，恢复由用户 检查记录后发起；正常 stop/tool_calls、取消和流错误遵循现有路径。
  5. 基线 v1 的镜像、失败记录、分数、case/adapter/runner/grader hashes 不改。 确定性重建对照和新的实测另存；原日志未记录的 length 必须标明为注入条件。

后果

一次响应结束与任务完成由同一 Loop 判定，不让 CLI/TUI 各自猜测 token 上限。 测试通过 run、run_interactive 和真实 CLI 入口覆盖，另检验旧事件解码兼容。 此修复不保证模型能在输出预算内解题，也不把未知 finish_reason 推断为 length。 预算内的解题稳定性与后续更广泛的恢复机制继续独立评测。
docs.excerpt: 记录 finish_reason；length 复用现有错误路径，不执行截断调用、不自动续写。

docs.title: ADR-0031：审阅事实、紧凑呈现与日志正文复用
docs.summary: 区分变化和覆盖未知；CLI 统一简报与详情；相同 digest 的快照正文复用日志既有内容，保持任务起点和单一持久真相。
docs.body_html:
状态

Accepted · 2026-10-21 · 用户授权实施 M6-011 至 M6-015，并优化高亮与运行反馈。

决策

  • agent 审阅投影返回结构化变化、覆盖缺口、检查与任务状态；未知 digest 不是变化证据。
  • CLI 负责文案和显示预算，任务结束仅一个呈现责任点；完整证据进入详情。
  • 快照仍在任务开始和结束采集。相同 digest 的 UTF-8 正文只需在同一日志记录一次；后续 text: null 可从此前快照中匹配并校验 digest 的正文恢复。没有对应正文时明确无法恢复 diff，不读取当前磁盘充当历史内容。
  • 取消后的收尾快照最多等待 100ms，超时明确记录覆盖未知；此前已记录的工具证据保留。正常任务仍使用既有扫描预算。
  • 不新增 core 字段，不改旧日志。投影只能使用目标事件之前的内容；fork 的前缀包含其引用内容，坏尾行不导致自动重放。
  • 哈希读取预算与正文保存预算分开：读取仍受文件/字节/时间限制；保存只包含日志尚未记录的正文。覆盖未知显式保留。
  • 临时 digest 集合可由日志重建，不是第二份持久状态。缓存有界，超出只降低去重率，不丢失证据。
  • 高亮在清洗和布局后由终端所有者生成，不接受模型 ANSI。状态动画仅刷新活动区，禁色/非 TTY 时保持静态，不改变 scrollback 或审批语义。

后果

旧版读者仍能读取事件，但可能把复用正文的历史 diff 显示为 unavailable；新版投影恢复完整已记录正文。 首次采集仍有成本；此方案降低正文重复写入，不声称无需扫描或覆盖整个仓库。 真实 Linux/macOS、复制、IME 与 Ghostty gate 仍需实机证据，自动化验收不替代。
docs.excerpt: 区分变化和覆盖未知；CLI 统一简报与详情；相同 digest 的快照正文复用日志既有内容，保持任务起点和单一持久真相。

docs.title: ADR-0032：向嵌入方暴露可复用前端与 turn hooks
docs.summary: 把 TUI 与 runtime 暴露为库，并提供通用 hook：prompt 追加、turn 结束、事件观察；不引入产品类型，不新增第二状态。
docs.body_html:
状态

Accepted · 2026-10-22。来自 niuse 的嵌入需求；上游讨论见 #1。

第一步已落地：niucode-cli 增加库目标，导出 run()、TurnHooks 与 NoHooks，并有一个链接测试。

第二步在 exec 路径落地：run_exec_with_hooks(ExecOptions, &mut dyn TurnHooks) 会在构造 AgentConfig 后调用 augment_system_prompt，在运行时事件上调用 on_event，并在首个 turn 结束后调用 on_turn_end；集成测试用 replay fixture 断言三者都发生。

TUI 路径已有 TuiOptions 与 run_tui_with_hooks，启动前调用 augment_system_prompt；TUI 循环与 live runner 通过共享的 Rc<RefCell<Box<dyn TurnHooks>>> 短借用，事件观察和 turn-end 均已接线。PTY + replay 的 example 探针确认三者都实际触发；renderer 迁移尚未开始。

第三步（2026-10-22）：EmbedderTool 与 AgentConfig.extra_tools 允许嵌入方注册只读工具，TuiOptions/ExecOptions 暴露同一入口。spec 与内建、扩展工具合并后按名分发；v1 在首轮前拒绝非只读工具和重名，子 agent 不继承。它不引入产品类型，也不是 extension host 的替代。

背景

niuse 需要复用 niucode 的 TUI、审批、diff 与 transcript，但 niucode-cli 目前只有 bin、没有 lib。结果是 niuse 自己驱动 turn、自己维护 renderer：同一套前端要演进两次，而且 niuse 无法复用终端验收。

niucode 的边界不能因此改变：内核仍然是最小 harness，不认识身份、记忆或任何伴侣概念。需要暴露的是通用的前端与生命周期 seam，不是产品能力。

决策

  1. niucode-cli 增加库目标，导出 TUI 入口、session runtime 与既有选项；二进制改为薄封装，行为与终端验收保持不变。

  2. 新增一个通用 hook trait，全部方法可选，默认为空：

    pub trait TurnHooks {
    fn augment_system_prompt(&mut self, _prompt: &mut String) {}
    fn on_turn_end(&mut self, _outcome: &RunOutcome) {}
    fn on_event(&mut self, _event: &AgentEvent) {}
    fn filter_text(&mut self, _text: &mut String) {}
    fn commands(&self) -> Vec<(String, String)> { Vec::new() }
    fn command(&mut self, _input: &str) -> Option<String> { None }
    fn after_turn(&mut self, _outcome: &RunOutcome) -> Vec<TurnPrompt> { Vec::new() }
    fn on_answer(&mut self, _id: &str, _choice: usize) {}
}

  3. augment_system_prompt 只能追加，不能替换基础 persona；on_turn_end 在最终 assistant 消息落盘后调用；on_event 只观察，不写日志。

  4. 未使用的 hook 不产生额外请求、事件或 prompt token；hook 不拥有持久状态，事件日志仍是唯一真相。

  5. 库 API 不出现身份、记忆、伴侣等产品类型；niuse 的 TurnHooks 实现留在 niuse。

  6. 实施顺序：先加库目标与空 hooks（行为不变），再把 renderer 从 niuse 迁回，最后让 niuse 的二进制只做装配。任何一步失败都可停在上一步。

后果

变好的：

  • niuse 可以复用 TUI、审批预览和终端验收，不再维护第二套前端。
  • 其他嵌入方得到同一条路径；niucode 的终端能力只有一处实现。
  • hook 面很小，必要时可以删除或替换，不影响 loop、事件或工具。

变差的：

  • niucode-cli 的公共 API 需要维护；hook 的调用时机一旦承诺就不好改。
  • 二进制与库的边界需要测试覆盖，否则容易出现“库能用、CLI 行为变了”。
  • M6 的终端所有权工作会被拉长；需要一个新的验收项。

接受的取舍： 先付出一次结构成本，换掉长期的双前端维护。若 hook 最终只服务 niuse 一个调用方，仍应保留通用形状，避免内核被产品需求污染。

备选

方案否决理由
niuse 继续维护自己的 renderer每一条 TUI 改进都要重做两次；审批与 diff 会逐渐分叉
把 niuse 并入 niucode monorepo改变 niucode 的定位与发布节奏；见 niuse ADR-0003
给 niucode 加 --profile personal把产品藏进内核，内核被迫理解身份与记忆
只暴露事件流，让 niuse 自建 TUI等于把前端复制一次，没有解决根因

实施草图（第一步已落地）

第一步不改变上面的决策，只把「接受之后第一小步做什么」拆到可评审的程度。src/lib.rs 现在承载 run()，src/main.rs 只剩 #[tokio::main] 封装；TurnHooks 的默认方法仍是空操作，exec 与 TUI 路径都已接线，renderer 仍未迁移。

1. 结构

  • niucode-cli 新增 src/lib.rs，把 main.rs 里的 main() 主体移成 pub fn run() -> ExitCode；bin 只保留一行调用。
  • 模块声明迁入 lib；所有 crate:: 路径保持原样。这一步只移动、不改行为，单独一个 commit，可单独 revert。
  • 库目标不改变现有二进制、安装方式和终端验收。

2. API

pub struct TuiOptions {
    // session path, cwd, policy, approval, config
}

pub trait TurnHooks {
    fn augment_system_prompt(&mut self, _prompt: &mut String) {}
    fn on_turn_end(&mut self, _outcome: &RunOutcome) {}
    fn on_event(&mut self, _event: &Event) {}
}

pub fn run_tui(options: TuiOptions, hooks: Box<dyn TurnHooks>) -> Result<()>;
  • augment_system_prompt 在构造 AgentConfig 之前调用一次。
  • on_event 由运行时观察者转发 AgentEvent，只读，不写日志；持久化的 Event 仍是唯一真相。
  • filter_text 在显示前修改一个 text delta；持久化的 Event 不变。它是嵌入方剥离自有协议块的 seam。
  • command 接收 TUI 不认识的 slash 命令，返回要打印的文本。
  • commands 把嵌入方命令注册进 /help 与 Tab completion；与 command 的运行时处理配合。
  • after_turn 返回通用问题，TUI 在回合结束后按编号询问，on_answer 收到零基选项；这是 candidate 确认的 seam。
  • on_turn_end 在最终事件落盘后调用。hook 不应 panic；库不额外捕获。
  • TuiOptions 只包含现有入口已经需要的字段，不引入产品类型。

3. 验收

  • 现有测试不改，cargo test --workspace 绿。
  • 空 hooks 的路径与当前行为一致：至少覆盖一次非交互 run 和一次 TUI 启动/退出。
  • 二进制仍能独立运行，--help、--version 与当前一致。
  • niuse 的契约测试在 pin bump 后通过；没有 hook 被使用时，不应多出请求、事件或 prompt token。

4. 回滚

第 1 步（库目标）与第 2 步（hooks）分开提交。任一步出问题都能回到纯 bin，不影响已发布版本和事件日志。

5. 不在这一步

  • 不迁移 niuse 的 renderer。
  • 不发布 crate、不改依赖版本策略。
  • 不改事件格式，不加第二份持久状态。
  • 不为了让 hook 好用而增加内核概念。
docs.excerpt: 把 TUI 与 runtime 暴露为库，并提供通用 hook：prompt 追加、turn 结束、事件观察；不引入产品类型，不新增第二状态。

docs.title: ADR-0033: MCP client v1 — stdio, explicit trust, read-only tools
docs.summary: A minimal MCP client: stdio servers from an explicit trust file, tools only, read-only in v1, with namespaced tools, audit events, timeouts, and no inherited credentials.
docs.body_html:
Status

Accepted · 2026-10-22. This is the first M8 (Connected harness) decision. It does not change the event log or the extension-host trust model.

Context

The extension host (ADR-0013) is a session-scoped, trusted local sidecar with a custom line-delimited JSON-RPC protocol. It solved capability-level external tools without kernel forks, but every integration writes a bespoke manifest and sidecar. MCP is the common protocol for tools and resources; a personal agent needs it to reach notes, calendars, and project services without a new integration per service.

Two things make a naive client dangerous:

  • an MCP server is an arbitrary local process that can read the environment, the filesystem, and the network;
  • an MCP tool executes outside niucode's built-in approval and write-lock path.

The current extension host already accepts mutating tools without an approval prompt; repeating that for MCP would widen the least-bounded surface in the harness.

Decision

  1. stdio only in v1. No HTTP/SSE transport, no remote URL, no OAuth. A server is a local command with argv and cwd.
  2. Explicit trust, never auto-discovery. Servers live in ~/.niucode/mcp.toml with name, command, args, optional env, and read_only = true. A workspace .niucode/mcp.toml is not read in v1. Nothing starts unless the user wrote it down.
  3. Tools only. Resources, prompts, sampling, and elicitation are out of scope. They need their own permission model.
  4. Read-only in v1. A manifest must declare read_only = true; the client rejects a server whose tools are not read-only until a mutating proposal with approval, preview, and a shared write lock exists.
  5. Namespaced and collision-checked. Exposed names are mcp__<server>__<tool>; a collision with a built-in, embedder tool, or another server is a startup error.
  6. No inherited credentials. Spawn with a scrubbed environment; only variables named in the manifest are passed. The server does not receive provider keys, auth tokens, or NIUCODE_* state.
  7. Bounded and observable. Initialize, list, and call have timeouts; the process group is killed on shutdown; stdout is parsed as line-delimited JSON and stderr is logged, never treated as protocol. Mount and call produce events so replay can explain where a tool came from.
  8. One tool budget. A result is capped by the same tool-output budget as built-ins and enters the conversation only through the loop's normal transcript projection.

Consequences

Better

  • One protocol for many personal services, without a new manifest format per service.
  • The trust decision is visible in one file and one ADR.
  • Read-only v1 cannot mutate the user's data or bypass approvals.

Worse

  • Read-only limits usefulness until a mutating design lands.
  • stdio-only excludes hosted MCP servers; that is deliberate for v1.
  • Each server adds a process to supervise and a failure mode to report.

Alternatives

  • HTTP/SSE first. Rejected: more auth, more network surface, no personal need yet.
  • Import MCP tools through the extension host. Rejected: the extension protocol and MCP have different lifecycles; a separate client keeps both contracts honest.
  • Allow mutating tools with the existing extension host behaviour. Rejected: it has no approval story and would make MCP the least-guarded write path.
  • Auto-discover servers from the workspace. Rejected: a cloned repository must not be able to start a local process.

Caveat

MCP servers are still arbitrary code running as the user. The manifest is a trust decision, not a sandbox. v1 is for servers the user chose and reviewed; network and filesystem confinement remain an M4-007-class capability gate.
docs.excerpt: A minimal MCP client: stdio servers from an explicit trust file, tools only, read-only in v1, with namespaced tools, audit events, timeouts, and no inherited credentials.

docs.title: ADR-0034: Mutating MCP — explicit tool allowlist and per-call approval
docs.summary: Mutating MCP stays off by default. A write-enabled server names each write tool, mounts only with an explicit flag and an interactive approval mode, and every call is approved with its arguments and recorded.
docs.body_html:
Status

Accepted · 2026-10-23 (human sign-off). Implementation starts in M8-002. Until the first write tool ships, the client keeps the ADR-0033 rule in production: only read_only = true servers mount, and read_only = false is refused before spawn.

Context

Read-only MCP is shipped and tested. The next useful personal pack (create a note, add a calendar entry) needs a write. The existing write paths have three properties MCP currently lacks:

  • a human sees the proposed change before it lands;
  • built-in writes share a workspace write lock;
  • the result is auditable in the event log.

An MCP server is an arbitrary local process. niucode cannot inspect a generic write_note argument and produce a trustworthy diff, cannot confine a process that ignores its declared roots, and cannot undo a remote side effect. The design must therefore be explicit about what approval means: the human trusts the server and approves the exact tool plus arguments, not a filesystem diff.

Decision

  1. No write by default. A server with read_only = false is refused unless both conditions hold: the manifest names the write tools in write_tools = [...], and the run passes --allow-mcp-write.
  2. Per-tool allowlist, never write = true. Every mutating tool must be named. A listed tool that the server does not expose is a mount error, not a silent omission. Unlisted tools remain read-only.
  3. Interactive approval only. A mutating call requires an approval mode with a human in the loop (ask or review). never, full-access, --json, and other non-interactive paths do not mount write-enabled servers. "Always allow" is not offered in v1.
  4. Approval shows the call, not a fake diff. The prompt contains the namespaced tool, the server, and a bounded JSON argument preview. The text says the effect is server-defined. Denial is a tool error and is recorded.
  5. Shared lock, honest limits. A mutating call takes the same write lock as built-in writes so the agent cannot interleave its own edits. The lock is serialization, not a sandbox: the server still runs as the user and may touch anything it can. The manifest is the trust boundary.
  6. No retry on timeout. A timed-out mutation has an unknown outcome. The client kills the process group, records the failure, and tells the model not to retry without human confirmation.
  7. Bounded result and arguments. Argument preview and tool output use the existing tool-output budget. Secrets are not redacted automatically; the manifest must not put credentials in arguments the agent can read.
  8. Audit. Every mutating call writes the existing approval event (allowed/denied) and tool_result; a mount writes its config hash and the write-tool list. No new durable store.
  9. No subagent inheritance. A subagent never receives mutating MCP tools. A future worker profile needs its own approval design.
  10. stdio only. No HTTP transport or remote OAuth in this slice.

Consequences

Better

  • A write cannot happen without a human seeing the tool and arguments.
  • read_only = false alone cannot silently widen the surface.
  • The audit trail uses events that already exist.

Worse

  • Approval quality depends on the arguments being legible; a tool that hides its effect behind a blob is dangerous even when approved.
  • No automatic rollback, diff, or filesystem confinement.
  • Write-enabled servers are useless in headless/JSON runs by design.

Alternatives

  • Treat all server tools as read-only and rely on the server. Rejected: names lie; the harness would claim a guarantee it cannot enforce.
  • Require a dry-run/diff tool before apply. Attractive, but not part of MCP and not implementable for arbitrary servers. Revisit if a pack adopts a preview convention.
  • Run servers in a container. Stronger, but a separate sandbox project; does not replace approval.
  • Auto-approve in full-access. Rejected: full-access is about the workspace, not an arbitrary external process.

Open questions for the human

  • Is per-call approval enough, or should a write-enabled server also require a one-time session confirmation at mount?
  • Should a denied call be visible in niuse evidence as denied even when the model retries?
  • Do we need a manifest roots field for documentation, knowing it is not enforced?
docs.excerpt: Mutating MCP stays off by default. A write-enabled server names each write tool, mounts only with an explicit flag and an interactive approval mode, and every call is approved with its arguments and recorded.

docs.title: ADR-0035: Render Markdown at the terminal boundary
docs.summary: The event log stays raw; the transcript parses inline Markdown into styled spans, buffers pipe tables into a block renderer, and leaves math as a readable fallback until a dedicated renderer exists.
docs.body_html:
Status

Accepted · 2026-10-23. First slice implemented in markdown.rs and table.rs for niucode's TUI.

Context

The TUI currently prints assistant text verbatim. Users see **bold**, `code`, and Markdown tables as literal punctuation. A terminal has no DOM: styling is ANSI spans, width is measured in cells, and a table needs the whole block before column widths are known.

The event log is the source of truth and must stay unchanged. Rendering is a presentation concern; the same raw text may later feed a web client, which can use a real Markdown/KaTeX renderer.

Decision

  1. Parse inline Markdown into spans (bold, italic, code, link, strike) before styling. Unbalanced markers stay literal while streaming.
  2. Strip ATX heading markers and render a level-aware heading style: H1 accent bold underlined, H2 accent bold, H3+ cyan. List markers become bullets/tasks, and > becomes a muted quote bar.
  3. Buffer consecutive pipe-table lines and render them as a box table only when the block ends. Column widths are cell-width based and capped to the viewport. Header rows are bold and borders dim via line metadata; styling never changes cell width. Cell inline styles are carried as byte ranges and applied to spans in both inline and linear modes.
  4. Code fences bypass Markdown parsing; the fence markers are replaced by a ▎ language label. A line-based token classifier colors keywords, strings, comments, numbers, and calls without changing text or width. Stateful block comments and triple-quoted strings span lines; the web renderer shares that classifier and emits token classes in escaped HTML.
  5. Math uses a readable Unicode fallback for common TeX ($...$, $$...$$, \alpha, \frac, \sqrt); $$ blocks are buffered and lose their fences, and unmatched $ stays literal. A web surface may render full TeX. No terminal TeX engine is promised.
  6. Rendering never writes to the session log and never trusts model-provided ANSI; existing sanitization stays.
  7. Styling must preserve text width: styles change attributes, not characters, except for the deliberate removal of Markdown markers.

Consequences

Better

  • Readable emphasis, code, headings, links, and tables in the TUI and linear fallback.
  • One parser feeds ratatui spans and linear ANSI, so the two paths stay close.
  • The raw log remains portable to a future web renderer.

Worse

  • Tables delay until the block ends; a streaming table appears at once.
  • Math is literal until the web renderer exists.
  • Very wide tables truncate with … rather than horizontal scrolling.

Follow-ups

  • Lists, block quotes, and task checkboxes.
  • Table cell styling and alignment for inline spans.
  • Streaming animation and progress polish (separate ADR/slice).
  • Web surface with Markdown + KaTeX; see rendering.
docs.excerpt: The event log stays raw; the transcript parses inline Markdown into styled spans, buffers pipe tables into a block renderer, and leaves math as a readable fallback until a dedicated renderer exists.

docs.title: ADR-0036: Local web surface
docs.summary: A local-only HTTP surface starts as a read-only session viewer; chat, SSE, approvals, and KaTeX follow without adding a remote control plane.
docs.body_html:
Status

Accepted · 2026-10-23. v0 is the read-only niucode web viewer.

Context

The TUI is the reference client, but a browser is better for long Markdown, tables, and math. A web surface must not become a remote control plane for the agent or a second source of truth. The event log already has the session shape; the missing piece is a local transport and a rendering client.

Decision

  1. Local only. Bind 127.0.0.1; no 0.0.0.0, no remote auth, no cloud relay. A future opt-in remote mode needs its own ADR and threat model.
  2. Start read-only. v0 serves one session plus a live tail: GET /, GET /api/session, GET /api/health, GET /api/events (chunked SSE), and POST /api/prompt for one read-only turn at a time (202/409). Runtime deltas are broadcast as ephemeral SSE events while the append-only log remains the durable source. Browser prompts use workspace-write + ApprovalMode::Ask; an approval event blocks the turn until POST /api/approval allows or denies it (300s timeout fails closed). Assistant text is rendered to HTML server-side with raw HTML escaped and javascript: links blocked; the web client uses that HTML only for final messages. Math uses native MathML from latex2mathml, with escaped fallback and no remote assets. An embedder may supply brand and context; a live context_provider is called per /api/context request, feeding a collapsible/filterable sidebar, and /api/status exposes model/cwd/policy for the header. A finished turn emits context_changed so the sidebar refetches. Approval previews and tool calls/results are rendered as escaped structured cards, not raw JSON. SSE phase events drive a client-side turn timer; text_delta carries accumulated rendered HTML, and the durable usage comes from turn_end. The composer is a multi-line textarea with local prompt history and /help /status /report /clear commands; code blocks have a Copy button, the session can be downloaded as derived Markdown, and a local search filters transcript nodes. The viewport follows new output only when already near the bottom, with a jump-to-latest control otherwise. A persisted dark/light/high-contrast toggle, first-run OS color/contrast preferences, and prefers-reduced-motion affect presentation only. Controls have accessible names; the transcript is a polite log region. Sections tagged threads switch archived sessions through an embedder allowlist, and successful new/switch operations broadcast session_switched. A Rust test checks DOM IDs and getElementById references in the embedded client; an optional headless-Chrome test loads the file with a stubbed SSE and asserts the log role, brand, and composer. A visual audit caught a header chip/button specificity bug, now covered by a static assertion. Read-only remains the default for the CLI.
  3. Same truth. The viewer reads the append-only session log; it never mutates it. Static assets are embedded; the client loads no remote asset.
  4. No build step. One embedded HTML/CSS/JS file, no npm, no bundler. This keeps the local install simple and offline.
  5. Protocol before chat. The next slice adds SSE events and a prompt POST with explicit approval round-trips; every browser action maps to an existing runtime event, not a parallel model.
  6. Boundary. niucode owns the server, protocol, and reference client; niuse owns identity/memory/product defaults and may embed or reskin the surface. No niucode source is forked into niuse.
  7. Security headers. nosniff, no-store, and a strict content type on every response. No cookies in v0; no secrets in the HTML.

Consequences

Better

  • Rich rendering work can land on the web without destabilizing the TUI.
  • The event log is directly inspectable in a browser.
  • Offline and loopback-only by construction.

Worse

  • v0 cannot chat or approve; it is a viewer.
  • A browser client duplicates presentation work (Markdown/KaTeX) that the TUI approximates in ANSI.
  • No authentication means loopback only until a later design.

Follow-ups

  • SSE /api/events and POST /api/prompt.
  • Approval cards with allow/deny POSTs.
  • Markdown + KaTeX rendering; keep a no-JS fallback.
  • niuse product shell: identity/memory sidebars, dogfood/report views.
docs.excerpt: A local-only HTTP surface starts as a read-only session viewer; chat, SSE, approvals, and KaTeX follow without adding a remote control plane.

docs.title: Rendering and experience roadmap
docs.summary: Phased plan for rich terminal output, motion, and a local web surface, with the event log kept raw.
docs.body_html:
Goal

Make niucode's transcript and niuse's companion surface pleasant to read: emphasis, code, tables, math fallback, clear progress, and eventually a web client — without turning the event log into presentation data.

Phases

P1 · Inline Markdown and tables (in progress)

  • markdown::inline: bold, italic, inline code, links, strikethrough.
  • ATX headings lose their # markers and carry level-aware emphasis (M9-047).
  • table::render: buffered pipe tables, borders, alignment, width cap.
  • Both linear ANSI and ratatui spans use the same spans.
  • Tests: parser edge cases, table widths, PTY visible output.

P2 · Blocks and polish

  • Lists, block quotes, task checkboxes, horizontal rules. M9-003 covers -/* bullets, ☐/☑ tasks, and > quotes; ordered lists keep 1..
  • Table cells reuse inline spans; numeric right alignment. M9-019 folds header/border tone into table line metadata; M9-020 carries cell inline styles as byte ranges.
  • Code fences are hidden and replaced by a ▎ language label. M9-004; M9-021 adds line-based token highlighting.
  • Math fallback conventions ($…$, $$…$$) and copy-friendly output. M9-005 buffers display blocks and strips the $$ fences. Included in M9-002: common symbols, \frac, \sqrt; unmatched $ is literal.
  • Link display strategy for terminals without hyperlink support.

P3 · Motion and progress

  • Streaming caret or shimmer that can be disabled. M9-006 adds a ▍/▏ caret and a per-tool elapsed timer.
  • Per-tool progress with elapsed time and a stable collapsed line. M9-027 adds one → tool marker per type per turn; failures stay explicit. M9-051 adds an aggregated per-tool timing line at task completion.
  • Completion transitions that do not reflow history.
  • Respect NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, and reduced-motion environments.

P4 · Web surface

  • v0 (M9-007): loopback-only read-only viewer, embedded static client, /api/session; M9-040 adds a derived Markdown download; M9-041 adds local transcript search; M9-043 adds an explicit new session; M9-049 switches archived sessions through an embedder allowlist and broadcasts session_switched (M9-050); M9-044 follows new output only when near the bottom; M9-045 adds light/reduced-motion support; M9-052 adds high contrast; M9-053 adds accessible names, a log region, and OS preference defaults.
  • Live tail (M9-008): /api/events chunked SSE, initial log + appended lines.
  • Read-only chat (M9-009): POST /api/prompt, one turn at a time, hard-coded read-only/never, embedded composer. M9-031 makes it multi-line; M9-032 adds local prompt history; M9-035 adds local /help /status /report; M9-036 rejects unknown slashes without a model turn; M9-037 adds a filtering completion menu; M9-038 adds a view-only /clear; M9-048 adds /threads context focus.
  • Streaming (M9-010): runtime deltas broadcast over SSE and finalized by the durable assistant event.
  • Approvals (M9-011): browser Allow/Deny releases a blocked approver; previews are serialized; unknown IDs 404. M9-024 renders them as readable diffs.
  • Markdown (M9-012): server-rendered HTML with escaped raw HTML, tables, and safe links.
  • Math (M9-013): native MathML from common TeX, escaped fallback, no remote assets. KaTeX remains an optional upgrade.
  • Code (M9-022): fenced code keeps its language and token colors in the browser via escaped server-rendered HTML. M9-026 carries multi-line block-comment state; M9-028 keeps triple-quoted strings across lines; M9-033 adds a Copy button.
  • Streaming (M9-023): each text delta carries accumulated rendered HTML, so Markdown forms while the turn is still running.
  • Tools (M9-025): collapsible call/result cards with escaped, bounded input/output.
  • Context (M9-015): embedder brand + /api/context + generic sidebar. M9-029 makes sections collapsible/filterable; M9-030 refreshes them after turns and remembers collapsed groups; M9-034 emits context_changed for immediate reloads; M9-039 shows page-local token usage in the header.
  • Status (M9-016): model/cwd/policy chips from /api/status.
  • Turn timer (M9-017): SSE phases drive a busy chip and elapsed timer; the context sidebar can be collapsed. See ADR-0036.
  • A local HTTP + SSE server over the same agent loop and event log.
  • Static, no-build client; Markdown and KaTeX rendering.
  • Session list, streaming answer, tool/approval cards, cancel.
  • Explicit local-only binding and token; no remote exposure in v1.
  • The kernel/product split: niucode owns the protocol and reference client; niuse owns identity, memory, and product defaults.

Invariants

  • The event log stays raw text; rendering is derived.
  • Model-provided ANSI is scrubbed.
  • Width and cursor calculations use terminal cell width, not bytes.
  • Every phase ships tests, docs, and a dashboard card.
docs.excerpt: Phased plan for rich terminal output, motion, and a local web surface, with the event log kept raw.

docs.title: MCP stdio client
docs.summary: MCP stdio: read-only by default, opt-in writes with an allowlist and per-call approval, manifest shape, and limits.
docs.body_html:
Status

The niucode-mcp crate implements the v1 client and host from ADR-0033: spawn, initialize, tools/list, tools/call, and a multi-server host over newline-delimited JSON on stdio. AgentConfig.mcp_host advertises namespaced specs and dispatches them in the turn loop. It is covered offline by a Python fixture server, including list, call, tool error, environment scrubbing, timeout, host mounting, collisions, and an agent turn.

exec and the TUI load ~/.niucode/mcp.toml (or --mcp-config PATH), mount read-only servers, print one mcp: <server> · <n> tool(s) line per mount, and shut the children down at the end of the run. The host is shared by both paths.

Manifest

~/.niucode/mcp.toml is explicit trust. A workspace file is never read.

[[server]]
name = "notes"
command = "python3"
args = ["/home/me/notes-server.py"]
read_only = true

[server.env]
NOTES_DIR = "/home/me/notes"

Only server.env is passed to the child. read_only = false is refused unless the manifest names every mutating tool and the run passes --allow-mcp-write with an interactive approval mode (ask or on-failure). Unnamed tools from a write server stay read-only; a named tool the server does not expose fails the mount. --json and --approval never mount read-only servers only.

[[server]]
name = "notes"
command = "python3"
args = ["/home/me/notes-server.py"]
read_only = false
write_tools = ["create_note", "update_note"]

Every mutating call is approved with the namespaced tool, server, and a bounded JSON argument preview. The prompt says the effect is server-defined; denial writes no change. A timeout is not retried [ADR-0034].

Rules

  • mutating calls take the shared write lock and are never inherited by subagents.
  • stdio only; no HTTP/SSE.
  • tools only; no resources, prompts, sampling, or elicitation.
  • namespaced as mcp__<server>__<tool>; collisions are startup errors.
  • stdout is protocol, stderr is diagnostics; a child that hangs is killed at the timeout.
  • the child is an ordinary local process running as the user. The manifest is a trust decision, not a sandbox.

Verify

cargo test -p niucode-mcp
cargo test -p niucode --test mcp
niucode exec --mcp-config /path/to/mcp.toml "list the notes"
docs.excerpt: MCP stdio: read-only by default, opt-in writes with an allowlist and per-call approval, manifest shape, and limits.

docs.title: Release 0.1.7 (draft)
docs.summary: Draft notes for the next niucode release: local web surface, streaming Markdown, approvals, TUI rendering, and verification evidence.
docs.body_html:
Status

Draft. Not published. Version numbers in the workspace are still 0.1.6; a release requires a coordinated bump and publication order.

Highlights

  • Local web surface (niucode web --session <jsonl>): loopback-only HTTP + SSE, embedded client, no build step, no remote assets. See ADR-0036.
  • Browser chat: read-only/workspace-write turns, streamed Markdown and MathML, visible approvals with structured diffs, tool cards, session export, transcript search, prompt history, and slash commands.
  • TUI rendering: inline Markdown, tables with styled cells, lists/rules, math fallback, code-fence labels, token highlighting, and multi-line code comment/string state.
  • Motion/progress: streaming caret, per-tool elapsed footer, compact per-tool markers.
  • Web status/context: model/cwd/policy chips, turn timer, token usage, product context sidebar, context_changed refresh.

Verification

cargo +1.88.0 check --workspace --all-targets
cargo test --workspace
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo package -p niucode --allow-dirty

Last run: MSRV clean, workspace tests/clippy green, package verifies and includes assets/web.html and src/web.rs.

Release order

  1. Bump all niucode workspace crates to 0.1.7; update sibling version requirements.
  2. Publish foundation crates first (niucode-core, niucode-auth, niucode-provider, niucode-tools, niucode-agent, ...), then niucode-mcp, niucode, if the release includes those changes.
  3. Verify cargo install niucode --version 0.1.7.
  4. Bump niuse to 0.1.13, require niucode = 0.1.7, publish.
  5. Update niuse/niucode.rev and docs/compat.md.

Blockers

  • Human approval to publish.
  • Version bump has not been applied.
  • Registry package verification cannot pass for a new sibling API until the foundation crates are published; the CLI package itself verifies at the current version.
docs.excerpt: Draft notes for the next niucode release: local web surface, streaming Markdown, approvals, TUI rendering, and verification evidence.

docs.title: 看板维护指南
docs.summary: docs/ 的源文件、构建命令、architecture-first 视图与每次迭代的更新仪式。
docs.body_html:
这是什么

docs/index.html 是项目唯一的架构阅读面：Architecture / Work / Docs / Decisions 共享一个三栏壳。它由仓库里的源文件生成，离线可开，不依赖服务端。

cargo xtask dashboard          # 生成 docs/index.html + model.json + receipt.json
cargo xtask dashboard --check  # CI：生成物过期、引用断开时失败

构建是确定性的：相同输入生成相同 HTML。receipt.json 记录构建时间、git revision 和输入清单，但不参与过期判断，也不入库。

四个视图

  • Architecture（默认）：按语义层排列模块，显示依赖关系、模块状态、contract、owned paths 和源码。选中模块会聚焦它的关系，弱化无关节点；不提供 zoom/pan。
  • Work：卡片和状态列，可按里程碑筛选。它是 agent 的 handoff 面，不是进度仪表盘；不显示完成率、进度条、WIP 数字或卡片计数。
  • Docs：Markdown 文档索引，右栏阅读，支持 #/docs/adr-0001 深链。组件与学习路径见 roadmap.md。
  • Decisions：ADR 卡片 + kind = "decision" 的决策日志。这里不放“某张卡完成”的流水账。

进度信息仍然存在于 docs/board/ 和 git 里；只是不再占据第一屏。

源文件

docs/
  index.html                  # 生成物，提交，file:// 可开
  dashboard/
    project.json              # 项目、里程碑、层、模块、关系、决策事件
    template.html             # 单文件壳
    style.css                 # 三栏与四个视图的样式
    app.js                    # 无框架渲染
    model.json                # 生成物：解析后的完整模型
    receipt.json              # 本地审计信息，gitignore，不入库
  board/
    M0-001-workspace.md       # 一张卡一个文件
  adr/
    0001-rust-core.md
    0002-event-log.md
    0003-architecture-first-dashboard.md
    0004-session-runtime.md
    0005-auth.md
    0006-sandbox.md
    0007-diff-preview.md
    0008-compaction.md
    0009-instructions-metrics.md
    0010-event-ids-replay-fork.md
    0011-subagents.md
    0012-exec-json.md
    0013-extension-host.md
    0014-profiles-plan-goal.md
  architecture.md
  auth.md
  exec.md
  provider.md
  roadmap.md
  tui.md
  README.md

唯一真相：project.json + board/*.md + 其余 Markdown。index.html、model.json、receipt.json 永不手改。

卡片格式

卡片 frontmatter 用 TOML，正文是给详情栏读的 Markdown：

+++
id = "M0-005"
title = "Provider trait 与流式适配"
status = "ready"          # backlog | ready | doing | review | done | blocked
milestone = "M0"
module = "providers"      # 可省略；必须是 project.json 里的模块 id
size = "L"                # S | M | L
priority = "P0"           # 可省略；P0 | P1 | P2
updated = "2026-10-20"
completed = "2026-10-20"  # done 必填
depends_on = ["M0-002"]
docs = ["architecture"]   # 可选；必须是文档 id
blocked_reason = ""       # blocked 必填
+++

正文建议四段：## 范围、## 验收、## 记录，需要时加 ## 开放问题。验收写成可执行的检查，不写“体验良好”。

文档格式

所有 docs/**/*.md（board/ 和 dashboard/ 除外）必须有 frontmatter：

+++
id = "adr-0003"
title = "ADR-0003：..."
kind = "adr"              # adr | doc | guide
status = "accepted"       # ADR 必填：proposed | accepted | superseded | rejected | draft
order = 30
summary = "一句话，显示在文档卡片上。"
+++

文档 id 用于深链：#/docs/adr-0001。卡片里的 docs 引用按 id 校验。

架构模型

project.json 里手工维护，不从文件名推断：

  • milestones：M0–M3，状态 planned | active | done，同一时间最多一个 active。
  • layers：语义分层，不是目录树。
  • modules：职责、公开契约、拥有的路径、备注。active / done 至少有一个路径真实存在。
  • relations：from / to / label，两端必须是模块 id。
  • events：决策与里程碑事件；refs 可以指向卡片或文档 id。只有 kind = "decision" 会进入 Decisions 视图。

更新仪式

每次任务结束，按顺序做：

  1. 更新对应卡片的 status、updated、必要的 completed。
  2. 有架构决策就加一篇 ADR，并在 project.json 的 events 里加一条 decision。
  3. 如果模块边界、契约或路径变了，更新 project.json 的 modules / relations。
  4. 跑 cargo fmt --all && cargo test --workspace。
  5. 跑 cargo xtask dashboard，把 docs/index.html 一起提交。
  6. 在 AGENTS.md 的 definition of done 里确认这一步没有被跳过。

状态必须反映现实：没有 doing 的卡就不要写 doing；done 必须有完成日期和可验证的验收项。

校验规则

构建时会失败的情况：

  • schema version 不是 1；id 重复；里程碑 / 模块 / 文档引用不存在。
  • done 没有 completed；blocked 没有 blocked_reason；日期格式错误。
  • active / done 模块的路径一个都不存在。
  • ADR 的 status 不在允许集合。
  • 关系端点不是模块。
  • --check 时生成物与源不一致。

视觉约定

  • 暖纸色底、墨色文字、一个深绿强调色；状态色只用于状态。
  • 层色只用于模块导航、模块卡顶部细线和图例，不铺满背景。
  • 架构图是主角；文档区控制阅读宽度，不做满屏卡片墙。
  • 数字、ID、路径用等宽字体；正文用系统无衬线。
  • 不引 CDN、不引外部字体，保证 file:// 和离线环境一致。
  • 动效只用于聚焦和状态切换，不做装饰性动画。

不要擅自加的东西

  • 前端框架、Vite/Node 构建链：会破坏单文件和确定性构建。需要时先写 ADR。
  • 图表库、zoom/pan、拖拽编辑：模块少于 30 个时属于过度设计。
  • 进度仪表盘、完成率、WIP 数字：进度属于 Work / git，不属于 Architecture 第一屏。
docs.excerpt: docs/ 的源文件、构建命令、architecture-first 视图与每次迭代的更新仪式。

events.title: 选择 Rust 作为核心语言
events.detail: 性能优先，且需要单二进制、低内存和原生沙箱。开发迭代的编译成本用 workspace 拆分和 fixture 测试抵消。

events.title: 事件日志作为唯一真相
events.detail: 内存状态只是日志的 fold；resume、fork、replay 都从日志派生，压缩只改变投影。

events.title: M0 开工：workspace、看板与会话日志
events.detail: 落地 cargo workspace、离线看板 v0、SessionLog 与 CLI 骨架。

events.title: Dashboard 以架构为第一屏
events.detail: 默认 Architecture，Work 降为二级；进度装饰移除，Decisions 只收决策。ADR-0003。

events.title: Interface 抽象会话，不抽象界面
events.detail: SessionRuntime 以 Command/Event 为边界；CLI/TUI 进程内消费，Web 先做只读 viewer。ADR-0004。

events.title: Provider 先做 OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions
events.detail: DeepSeek 与 OpenAI 共用一套 SSE 适配；先不引入多 provider 抽象，验证 loop 后再扩展。

events.title: 凭证解析：env → keyring → 0600 file
events.detail: 不打印密钥；keyring 不可用时回退文件；不支持网页账号 cookie。

events.title: 最小 niucode exec 闭环打通
events.detail: 真实 DeepSeek 文本与 read tool call 验证通过；本地 mock 覆盖 text/tool 两条路径。

events.title: 六工具与 loop 加固完成
events.detail: grep/glob、bash 进程组与超时、Ctrl-C 取消、fixture 修复测试都已落地。

events.title: M0 完成：可恢复、可回放的 exec 闭环
events.detail: resume、record/replay fixture、golden transcript 与六工具加固都已落地。

events.title: Linux 沙箱首选 bwrap，landlock/seccomp 后置
events.detail: 三轴策略独立；bwrap 提供文件系统与网络隔离，缺少 bwrap 时显式降级到逐工具审批。

events.title: Sandbox 三轴落地
events.detail: 默认 workspace-write + network off；read-only、full-access、审批与策略审计事件可用。

events.title: 线性 TUI 落地
events.detail: 流式文本、thinking 折叠、工具状态、单键审批、Ctrl-C 取消和 session 复用可用。

events.title: Diff 预览归工具层，客户端只负责渲染
events.detail: Toolbox::preview 按真实文件生成结构化 unified diff；loop 转发 ChangePreview，TUI 用宽度感知 pager 渲染，headless 输出纯文本。ADR-0007。

events.title: M1 完成：审批 diff pager 与工具输出折叠
events.detail: 完整 unified diff、按文件跳转、resize 重排、输出折叠和 :last 展开落地；M1 交互面收口。

events.title: Compaction 是事件日志上的确定性 handoff
events.detail: 按估算 token 的 75% 触发；保留最近 N 个 user turn，其余事件生成结构化 handoff。compaction.upto 是绝对事件下标，投影在其处插入摘要且不重写日志。ADR-0008。

events.title: M2-001 compaction 落地
events.detail: 上下文估算、确定性 handoff、compaction 事件、resume 回放与失败保留都已验证；下一步是 AGENTS.md 分层与缓存指标。

events.title: 分层 AGENTS.md 与缓存指标留在事件日志
events.detail: 每次 run 从 cwd 向上发现 AGENTS.md，近者优先，追加在稳定 system prompt 之后；instructions 事件记录 sources + digest；缓存命中率从 turn_end.usage 派生，不引入 Runs 看板。ADR-0009。

events.title: M2 完成：分层指令与缓存指标
events.detail: AGENTS.md 分层发现、instructions 审计事件、缓存命中率与 TUI 风格化落地；看板保持四视图。下一步 M3-001。

events.title: 事件 ID 用稳定序号，fork 复制前缀并追加溯源
events.detail: 事件 ID 是解码事件的 1-based 序号；replay 只做投影；fork 校验 ID、复制前缀、末尾追加 fork 事件，compaction.upto 不变。ADR-0010。

events.title: M3-001 replay 与 fork 落地
events.detail: 离线投影 replay、稳定事件 ID、前缀 fork、坏行截断与溯源事件都已验证；下一步 M3-002 subagent。

events.title: Subagent 是带独立日志的只读子运行
events.detail: 一个 subagent 工具并行跑 1–4 个只读任务；每个任务独立 session，父 session 只记录 spawn/result 和摘要路径。ADR-0011。

events.title: exec --json 是稳定的 JSONL 协议
events.detail: stdout 一行一个 JSON 事件，start 带 protocol=1；tool_result 只含 summary，完整输出留在 session 日志。ADR-0012。

events.title: M3 完成：replay/fork、subagent 与 JSONL 协议
events.detail: 稳定事件 ID、离线 replay、前缀 fork、并行只读 subagent 和 exec --json 都已落地；M0–M3 计划卡全部完成。

events.title: 小内核 + 外置 capability 插件
events.detail: 内置工具、loop、context、policy、auth、session 留在内核；external tools/commands 走 session 级 sidecar host；WASM 只做纯计算 tier。ADR-0013。

events.title: Profile、Plan mode 与 Goal 分离
events.detail: 用户只看 ask/review/full-access/ci；/plan 是运行时只读 mode；/goal 是目标标签；access/approval/reviewer/risk 留在实现层。ADR-0014。

events.title: M4 开始：可扩展与更顺手的交互
events.detail: M4-001 先落 CommandRegistry、TUI 自动菜单、/plan 和 /goal；extension host 与 subagent profile 随后。

events.title: M4-001 完成：TUI 自动菜单、/plan、/goal
events.detail: CommandRegistry 驱动自动补全和帮助；自定义行编辑器替换 rustyline；/plan 只读模式与 /goal 目标标签落事件日志。

events.title: M4-002 v1 完成：sidecar external tools
events.detail: workspace manifest + JSON-RPC initialize/tools/call/shutdown；env scrub、timeout、mount/unmount provenance；capability sandbox 与 worker pool 进 M4-007。

events.title: M4-002 v1 只做可信本地 sidecar
events.detail: 先验证 manifest/协议/事件/超时；不把未实现的 bwrap 网络隔离和 worker pool 写成已完成，统一进 M4-007。

events.title: Dashboard 重塑为 niuverse orbital console
events.detail: 使用组织 logo 与 favicon；dark-first 视觉、serif 标题、架构卡片、详情 inspector 与响应式布局全面重做。

events.title: M4-003 完成：Explore/Worker subagent profiles
events.detail: profile 写入 spawn 事件；Explore 只读 + 只读插件；Worker 可写并共享 W1 写锁，write_scope 约束 write/edit；mutating 插件不下放。

events.title: M4-004 完成：inherit 显式、可审计、不可递归
events.detail: subagent profile=inherit 需要 --allow-subagent-inheritance；复制父工具面但剥离 subagent，共享 sandbox/approval/write lock。

events.title: M4-005 完成：/goal run evaluator loop
events.detail: TUI 自动续跑最多 6 轮；独立无工具 evaluator 输出 goal_verdict；met 清 goal，impossible/预算耗尽停止；headless 版进 M4-008。

events.title: TUI interaction polish + /goal auto-start
